paper.paperTitle: GATS: Graph-Augmented Tree Search with Layered World Models for Efficient Agent Planning

impact_score.reason: 该论文提出 GATS 框架，通过 UCB1 树搜索与三层世界模型（符号匹配 → 统计学习 → LLM 预测）的组合，在规划阶段完全消除 LLM 推理调用，同时在合成任务和12个挑战性场景中达到100%规划成功率，显著优于 LATS（88.9%）和 ReAct（23.9%）。每任务零 LLM 调用（对比 LATS 的37次）和确定性输出（零方差）是实质性突破，挑战了'LLM 引导探索是智能体规划必需品'的行业共识。但所有实验基于合成/受控场景，未见真实 Web 或生产环境部署验证，且论文为 arXiv 预印本，未经同行评审。因此短期影响力属于'重要学术贡献，可能改变局部竞争格局'的级别，但尚未达到范式转移。综合评分 6.5。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 规划过程中零 LLM 调用即可实现更高成功率，大幅降低 Agent 推理成本并消除输出随机性

hype_assessment.reason: 论文本身学术语言较为克制，未使用'颠覆式'、'革命性'等 PR 术语，数据呈现也相对透明。但'100%成功率'和'零 LLM 调用'的表述具有天然传播冲击力，容易被媒体和社区简化为'Agent 规划已彻底解决'，忽略实验场景的合成性。此外，三层世界模型中 L2（统计学习）和 L3（LLM 预测）在未知动作场景下的泛化能力尚未充分验证。综合判定为中等炒作指数。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 提出 UCB1 树搜索与三层世界模型（L1 精确符号匹配 + L2 执行日志统计学习 + L3 LLM 预测兜底）的组合架构，在规划推理阶段完全消除 LLM API 调用，实现确定性规划和零运行方差。这一思路将智能体规划从'LLM 驱动试错'范式转向'系统化搜索 + 经验学习'范式，本质上是对 LLM Agent 规划层的重新设计。
domain_disruption.business_model: 若 GATS 的方法能推广到真实场景，将显著降低 AI Agent 服务商的推理成本（每任务零 LLM 调用 vs. LATS 的37次），使规划密集型 Agent 应用的毛利率大幅改善，可能加速 Agent 从演示级进入生产级部署。同时，'确定性规划'特性对金融合规、医疗决策等需要可审计结果回放的高风险场景具有直接商业价值。

compound_value.reason: GATS 的核心价值在于用经典树搜索（UCB1）+分层世界模型替代 LLM 推理调用来做智能体规划，将每任务的 LLM 调用从 37 次降至 0 次，同时实现确定性输出。这直接命中 AI Agent 落地中的两大痛点：推理成本高和输出不可控。从复利效应看，若该范式被验证能在真实场景（非合成任务）中规模化，有可能成为 Agent 规划层的基础设施——所有 Agent 系统都需要规划模块，而 GATS 的思路（系统搜索+学习型世界模型）比纯 LLM 引导更高效、更便宜。但必须保持审慎：论文实验在合成任务和 12 个精心设计的场景上进行，100% 成功率在真实开放环境中几乎不可能复现；且该工作目前仅为学术预印本，未开源、未产品化、无公司实体支撑。历史经验表明，学术界'完美结果'的规划框架在真实部署时往往需要大量适配。综合评估：方向正确、经济学诱人，但距离可投资的复利基础设施仍有较长验证周期，评分上限暂定 6.5，待看到真实场景复现、开源实现或公司级产品化后上调。

research_problem.core_question: 如何在不依赖LLM推理调用的情况下实现高效、确定性的大语言模型智能体规划？
research_problem.motivation: 现有LLM智能体规划方法（如LATS和ReAct）在规划过程中大量依赖LLM推理调用，导致计算成本高昂、行为随机性强、结果不可复现。随着LLM智能体在多步规划任务中的广泛应用，亟需一种能够兼顾规划质量与计算效率，同时保证输出确定性的新范式。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了LLM智能体规划中'LLM推理调用依赖'与'计算效率/确定性'之间的矛盾空白，首次提出在规划阶段完全消除LLM推理调用，通过结构化搜索与分层世界模型替代传统LLM引导的探索策略。

methodology.approach_summary: GATS提出了一种结合UCB1树搜索与三层分层世界模型的智能体规划框架。世界模型由三层构成：L1层使用精确符号动作匹配（如查找表或确定性规则），L2层从历史执行日志中统计学习动作结果模式（如成功概率分布），L3层对未知或未观测过的动作借助LLM进行预测。在规划阶段，GATS通过UCB1算法在分层世界模型中进行树搜索，优先探索高置信度的路径，完全不需要LLM推理调用，从而在保证100%任务成功率的同时实现确定性和零方差规划。
key_innovations: 提出三层分层世界模型，将精确符号匹配、统计学习和LLM预测有机结合，实现知识蒸馏后规划阶段零LLM调用
将UCB1树搜索系统性地应用于LLM智能体规划领域，替代传统LLM引导的随机探索策略
在规划阶段完全消除LLM推理调用，将每任务的LLM调用量从LATS的37次降至0次，同时提升规划成功率

title: A Theory of Least Autonomy in AI
author: [[Christophe Parisel]]
description: arXiv:2607.09744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Least privilege, the principle that an identity should hold only the permissions strictly required for its task, has been a foundational primitive of access control for decades. We argue that this principle is insufficient for agentic AI systems, which do not merely hold permissions but can combine, approve, and amplify them across workflows and system boundaries. We propose least autonomy as an appropriate generalization and develop a formal theory. First, we define a compositional blast radius d(a,b) that measures structural separation between actions in an enterprise hierarchy, combining an ultrametric tree with lattice-valued confidentiality, integrity, and control-context labels. Second, we define a directed agent influence graph G(theta). An arc from U to V requires a directed shared-resource write-to-read meeting or a conservative undirected agent-to-agent (A2A) communication meeting, and a meeting-conditioned influence potential at or above an externally selected policy threshold theta. A catalogue-radius profile supports calibration and audit of theta. Finally, we define a collusion predicate over graph reachability that detects authorization composition, decision manipulation, and cross-domain capability composition.

research_problem.core_question: 如何将访问控制中的最小权限原则泛化为适用于自主 AI 系统的'最小自主'原则，并为其建立形式化理论基础？
research_problem.motivation: 传统安全领域的最小权限原则（Least Privilege）要求身份仅持有严格必需的权限。然而，自主 AI 系统不仅仅持有权限，还能够跨工作流和系统边界组合、审批和放大权限。这种组合能力使得传统最小权限原则不足以应对 AI 代理带来的安全风险——一个被授予有限权限的 AI 代理可能通过与其他代理协作或组合授权来间接获得超出预期的能力。因此需要一种新的形式化框架来量化、约束和审计 AI 系统的自主性范围。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了传统最小权限原则无法处理 AI 代理间权限组合、跨域能力合成和决策操纵的理论空白，为 agentic AI 系统的安全约束提供了首个形式化框架。

methodology.approach_summary: 该论文提出了'最小自主'（Least Autonomy）原则作为最小权限原则的泛化，并构建了一个三组分的形式化理论体系：（1）定义了一个组合爆炸半径函数 d(a,b)，利用超度量树与格值机密性、完整性和控制上下文标签来度量企业层级中动作之间的结构分离程度；（2）定义了一个有向代理影响力图 G(θ)，其中边的存在取决于有向共享资源写-读关系或保守的无向代理间通信会议，以及超过策略阈值 θ 的影响力势；（3）定义了一个基于图可达性的共谋谓词，用于检测授权组合、决策操纵和跨域能力合成。整个框架通过目录半径配置文件（catalogue-radius profile）支持 θ 的校准与审计。
key_innovations: 提出'最小自主'原则作为最小权限原则在 agentic AI 场景下的自然泛化，将关注点从静态权限持有扩展到动态动作组合
构建了组合爆炸半径 d(a,b) 这一形式度量，融合超度量树与格值标签体系，能量化企业层级中动作间的结构性分离程度
设计了带策略阈值 θ 的有向代理影响力图和基于图可达性的共谋谓词，可形式化检测授权组合、决策操纵与跨域能力合成三类安全风险

title: Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Models in Straight-Through Underwriting
author: [[Robert Richardson, Josh Meyers, Brian Hartman, David Sandberg]]
description: arXiv:2607.07858v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is beginning to reshape actuarial practice, particularly in domains that require reasoning over unstructured documents, heterogeneous data sources, and regulated decision workflows. Actuaries now face a design space that ranges from traditional rule-based automation to large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent ``agentic'' systems that plan, retrieve, call tools, and reflect. This paper examines how these emerging architectures can support actuarial priorities such as transparency, auditability, and human-in-the-loop governance, with a focus on straight-through decision processes. To make these ideas concrete, we develop and analyze an agentic AI framework for straight-through underwriting of small commercial Business Owner Policies (BOPs). We construct a synthetic but realistic experimental environment and compare three underwriting pipelines: (i) a single-LLM baseline, (ii) a naive RAG system, and (iii) a multi-agent ``Agentic RAG'' pipeline that combines targeted retrieval, third-party data checks, and explicit multi-step rule evaluation. The agentic system performs best overall, with the largest gains in multi-step and missing-information scenarios, where structured retrieval and reflection help the model avoid unsupported straight-through decisions.
tldr: 论文比较了LLM、RAG和Agentic RAG三种架构在商业保单直通承保中的效果。
objective_summary: 该论文针对小型商业企业主保单(BOPs)的直通承保场景，构建合成实验环境，比较了单LLM基线、朴素RAG系统和多智能体Agentic RAG三种流水线。实验表明Agentic RAG在复杂多步骤和缺失信息场景中表现最优。
key_logic_flow: 该论文探讨了从传统规则自动化到大语言模型(LLM)、检索增强生成(RAG)以及多智能体代理型系统的设计空间，重点关注精算实践中的透明度、可审计性和人机协作治理需求。
论文针对小型商业企业主保单(BOPs)的直通承保场景，构建了一个合成但真实的实验环境来评估不同架构。
论文设计并比较了三种承保流水线：单LLM基线、朴素RAG系统、以及结合目标检索、第三方数据检查和显式多步规则评估的多智能体Agentic RAG流水线。
实验结果表明，Agentic RAG系统整体性能最佳，在多步骤和缺失信息场景中尤其突出，结构化检索和反思机制帮助模型避免了不支持的直通决策。

title: YUKTI: From Natural-Language Situations to Robust, Verifiable Decisions An Uncertainty-Typed Proposition IR, Assumption-Robust Pareto Frontiers, and a Regret Certificate
author: [[Suyash Mishra]]
description: arXiv:2607.09706v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models turn a worded situation into a numeric plan, and the dominant pipelines (NL4Opt, OptiMUS, ORLM, OR-LLM-Agent) commit to a single objective and point-valued coefficients, then solve once. For decisions that allocate real budget, effort, or clinical attention, that confidence is the failure mode: every objectified number is an assumption, and a plan optimal only if the guesses are exactly right is fragile -- mimicry of computation. YUKTI changes the target of autoformulation. Its representation is a typed-proposition graph whose relationships carry shape priors, coefficient uncertainty, and provenance. YUKTI routes each stage to an exact, nonlinear, or evolutionary solver; couples stages by a distributional Pareto hand-off; and introduces Assumption-Robust Pareto Frontiers (ARPF), resampling assumptions (including structural epsilon-contamination) to score how often each action survives (rho). We prove a bound making rho an exact factor of decision regret, add auditable traceability, and synthesize a benchmark-faithful data foundation when none exists (SRJANA). We validate three ways: under controlled misspecification the robust compromise cuts mean and tail regret by over 90% versus a naive point plan; on a regulated commercial decision we optimize inside a lawful action space and price the downside in euros; and on a real public dataset of 41,188 decisions an out-of-sample backtest beats the logged status quo by 34% and a naive point rule by 4% while reducing the optimizer's curse. The solvers are standard; we claim no benchmark-SOTA win. A head-to-head shows an LLM given the correct numbers, and single-objective optimization, both incur about 47x the held-out regret of YUKTI -- an LLM is a formulator, not a solver. Under long-range causal coupling, the forward hand-off becomes unsound, locating where it must become a backward-induction causal policy.
tldr: YUKTI 提出不确定性类型化命题图与假设鲁棒帕累托前沿，实现从自然语言到鲁棒可验证决策的转化。
objective_summary: YUKTI 将自然语言情境转化为带不确定性类型的命题图表示，通过假设鲁棒帕累托前沿（ARPF）重新采样假设评估动作鲁棒性，并证明其与决策遗憾的精确关系。在受控错误设定下均值与尾端遗憾降低超 90%，在 41,188 个真实决策数据集上回溯测试比现状提升 34%。
key_logic_flow: 现有管线（NL4Opt、OptiMUS、ORLM、OR-LLM-Agent）采用单一目标函数和点值系数进行单次求解，在真实资源分配决策场景中存在脆弱性。
YUKTI 的核心表示是带不确定性类型的命题图，每条关系携带形状先验、系数不确定性和来源追踪，路由各阶段至精确/非线性/进化求解器并通过分布帕累托接力耦合。
YUKTI 引入假设鲁棒帕累托前沿（ARPF），通过重新采样假设（包括结构 epsilon-污染）计算每个动作的生存频率 rho，并从理论上证明 rho 是决策遗憾的一个精确因子。
在受控错误设定下，YUKTI 的鲁棒折中方案比朴素点计划的均值与尾端遗憾降低超过 90%。
在 41,188 个决策的真实公开数据集上，YUKTI 的样本外回溯测试超越现状记录 34%，超越朴素点规则 4%，同时降低了优化器诅咒。
研究表明 LLM 是公式化工具而非求解器——给予正确数值和单一目标优化的 LLM 产生的保留遗憾约为 YUKTI 的 47 倍。

paper_metadata.title: YUKTI: From Natural-Language Situations to Robust, Verifiable Decisions An Uncertainty-Typed Proposition IR, Assumption-Robust Pareto Frontiers, and a Regret Certificate

research_problem.core_question: 如何将自然语言描述的情境转化为鲁棒且可验证的决策，而非仅仅依赖单一点估计进行确定性优化？
research_problem.motivation: 当前基于LLM的自动形式化管线（NL4Opt、OptiMUS、ORLM、OR-LLM-Agent）在处理自然语言决策问题时，会提取单一目标函数和点估计参数然后求解一次。这种范式在真实预算分配、临床资源分配等场景中本质上是脆弱的——每一个被物化的数字都隐含着一个假设，只有在所有猜测都精确无误时方案才真正最优。确定性优化在不确定环境下只是'计算的模仿'而非真正的决策推理。亟需一种能够保留不确定性、提供鲁棒性保证的全新自动形式化范式。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 现有LLM驱动的自动形式化管线完全缺乏不确定性建模和鲁棒性验证机制，无法区分'对点估计而言的最优解'和'在假设扰动下依然可靠的决策'之间的本质区别，且没有任何理论保证来量化决策的遗憾上界。

methodology.approach_summary: YUKTI提出了一种全新的自动形式化框架，核心表示是带不确定性类型的命题图（typed-proposition graph），其中关系携带形状先验、系数不确定性和来源追踪。YUKTI将每个子问题路由到精确求解器、非线性求解器或进化求解器，通过分布化Pareto交接实现阶段耦合。核心创新是假设鲁棒Pareto前沿（ARPF），通过重采样假设（包括结构ε-污染）来量化每个行动在各种假设下的存活频率（rho），并证明了rho是决策遗憾的精确因子（Regret Certificate）。系统还包含SRJANA数据合成框架，在缺乏真实基准时生成保真度高的评测数据，并提供了完整的可审计溯源链。
key_innovations: 提出带不确定性类型的命题图表示（Uncertainty-Typed Proposition IR），保留从自然语言提取过程中的所有不确定性信息而非坍缩为点估计，从根本上改变了自动形式化的表示范式
引入假设鲁棒Pareto前沿（ARPF），通过重采样假设分布（含结构ε-污染）量化每个决策行动的鲁棒性得分（rho），将鲁棒优化思想引入自然语言决策管线
证明rho是决策遗憾的精确因子（proved bound），为决策鲁棒性提供了严格的理论保证——这是该领域首个形式化的遗憾界
提出SRJANA数据合成框架，在缺乏真实基准时生成保真度高的评测数据，解决了鲁棒决策领域缺乏统一基准的痛点
inspiration_sources: 鲁棒优化理论（Robust Optimization）
Pareto前沿与多目标优化（Multi-objective Optimization）
不确定性量化（Uncertainty Quantification）
结构ε-污染模型（Structural Epsilon-Contamination）
LLM驱动的自动形式化管线（NL4Opt, OptiMUS, ORLM）

experimental_rigor.benchmark_coverage: 三重验证策略：（1）受控误设定实验——系统性地误设目标函数系数，比较鲁棒折中方案与朴素点方案的均值和尾部遗憾；（2）受监管商业决策场景——在法律约束的行动空间中优化并以欧元量化最坏情况损失；（3）大规模样本外回溯测试——使用包含41188个真实决策的公开数据集验证方法有效性。
experimental_rigor.claimed_improvement: 在受控误设定下，鲁棒折中方案相比朴素点方案将均值和尾部遗憾降低90%以上；在41188个真实决策的样本外回溯测试中，比记录状态提升34%，比朴素点规则提升4%，同时减少了优化者诅咒（optimizer's curse）；LLM给定正确数字和单目标优化均产生约47倍于YUKTI的持有外遗憾。

limitations_and_honesty.generalization_concern: 方法在受控实验和特定商业场景中表现亮眼，但跨领域泛化性尚未充分验证。当问题规模增大或因果结构复杂化时，前向Pareto交接的退化问题可能严重制约方法的适用边界。SRJANA合成数据生成的保真度直接影响最终决策质量，但目前缺乏系统的跨领域、跨复杂度的泛化能力评估。核心方法在更长因果链上需要完全不同的技术路线（反向归纳），暗示当前框架存在固有适用范围。

industrial_relevance.cost_efficiency_analysis: YUKTI使用标准求解器（精确、非线性、进化求解器），无需GPU或专用硬件，计算成本可控。与现有LLM管线相比，YUKTI不依赖多次LLM调用来反复生成不同参数估计，而是通过一次形式化后执行结构化鲁棒分析，可能在长期运行中降低总计算成本。但ARPF的重采样过程会引入额外计算开销，需要在鲁棒性增益与计算效率之间权衡。在高风险商业场景（如合规决策、大额预算分配）中，决策失误的代价远大于额外计算成本，因此成本效益优势明显。当前阶段仍需工程化适配才能集成到现有决策系统中。

related_work_context.advancement_over_prior: 现有管线（NL4Opt、OptiMUS、ORLM等）的核心范式是从自然语言中提取单一目标函数和点估计参数后直接求解最优解。YUKTI从根本上改变了这一范式：它不再将不确定性视为需要消除的噪声，而是将其显式建模为命题图的一部分，并通过ARPF对所有假设进行系统性重采样来评估决策的鲁棒性。这不仅在实验中实现了90%以上的遗憾降低，还通过Regret Certificate提供了严格的理论保证——这是所有现有工作完全缺失的。更关键的是，YUKTI明确了LLM的角色边界——LLM是形式化器而非求解器——纠正了领域内对LLM求解能力的过度自信，单目标优化被指出本质上是一种'计算的模仿'。

title: Physics-Audited Agentic Discovery in Scientific Machine Learning
author: [[Diab W. Abueidda, Bilal Ahmed, Panos Pantidis, Mostafa E. Mobasher]]
description: arXiv:2607.07379v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In agentic scientific machine learning (SciML), large language model (LLM) agents can discover surrogate models and select one by an automated score, typically an error metric. A low error, however, does not establish that the predicted fields satisfy the physics that matter for mechanics, such as boundary conditions, superposition, stiffness scaling, or causality. We introduce Physics-Audited Agentic SciML (PA-SciML), a verification-first workflow for agentic SciML discovery. The workflow fixes a scoring evaluator before search, derives reviewable machine-checkable physics requirements, checks each trained candidate on its outputs, and separately searches prescribed input ranges or measured load-history spans for high-violation cases without reference solution fields. A surrogate is reported as verified only under the stated checks. When enabled, the workflow also adds advisory numerical probes before training and tests one modeling change at a time to record which isolated edits are associated with score gains before reuse. In the reported computational-solid-mechanics numerical examples, the static elasticity run selects a surrogate with lower validation error than the error-only baseline while both selected models pass the common linear-elastic checks. In the transient elastodynamics run, an error-only baseline with similar mean error fails a stricter causality check by responding to future parts of the loading history, while the selected surrogate passes the stated checks. The main distinction is per-candidate physics evidence on predicted fields, not a richer aggregate score.

title: Persona Cartography: Charting Language Model Personality Traits in Weight Space
author: [[Luke Baines, Anton Gonzalvez Hawthorne, Mariia Koroliuk, Irakli Shalibashvili, Cl\'ement Dumas, Konstantinos Voudouris, David Demitri Africa]]
description: arXiv:2607.07916v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models exhibit recurring behavioural patterns -- personas -- that shape generalisation and safety, but we lack reliable tools for decomposing, measuring, and controlling them. Our central insight is to treat personas as positions in a space of behavioural traits, using the OCEAN framework to describe model personas in terms of Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism. We train low-rank adapters to amplify or suppress individual traits, and evaluate their effects using an LLM-judge calibrated against a human-validated panel, trait-specific multiple-choice benchmarks, and standard capability evaluations. Across six models from three families (4B-32B), we find that each adapter moves its target trait largely monotonically with scale, combines approximately additively with other adapters to construct mixed personas, and preserves performance on capability benchmarks at moderate scales. We further show that the induced trait axes affect safety-relevant behaviour in downstream evaluations: for example, moving along neuroticism and agreeableness axes affects frustration and sycophancy respectively. We also introduce an unsupervised psychometric pipeline that recovers four interpretable behavioural factors (tone, initiative, didacticism, epistemic caution) from model rollouts. Persona control can then be considered in terms of learning, scaling, and composing traits in weight space, providing a bridge between personality measurement, model editing, and safety.
tldr: 将大语言模型的行为个性映射到OCEAN五因素人格空间，通过LoRA适配器实现对个性特质的测量与控制。

title: Format Sensitivity Index: Token-Controlled Prompt Wrapper Robustness and Schema Compliance in LLM Benchmarking
author: [[Deep Pankajbhai Mehta]]
description: arXiv:2607.09665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Prompt wrappers often differ only in formatting, yet they can change model scores enough to flip leaderboard conclusions. We study this variance under a token-controlled protocol and introduce two complementary metrics: the Format Sensitivity Index (FSI), the accuracy range induced by wrapper choice, and the Parseability Sensitivity Index (PSI), the corresponding range in answer parseability. Across 140,000 OpenRouter generations spanning 7 QA tasks, 5 wrapper families, and 4 instruct models from 7B to 72B parameters, we find that mean FSI varies by over 30x across models and is largely explained by compliance failures. A fixed-effects regression shows that parseability remains a strong predictor of accuracy even after controlling for task, model, and wrapper. We argue that reporting accuracy without wrapper variance and compliance is statistically fragile, and we give practical recommendations for both benchmarking and structured-output deployments.

paper_metadata.title: Format Sensitivity Index: Token-Controlled Prompt Wrapper Robustness and Schema Compliance in LLM Benchmarking

research_problem.core_question: 提示模板的格式变化在多大程度上影响LLM的基准测试得分，以及如何量化这种格式敏感度？
research_problem.motivation: 在LLM基准测试中，仅存在格式差异的提示包装器（如不同的分隔符、标记结构等）即可导致模型得分发生足以翻转排行榜结论的变化。然而，现有基准测试报告仅报告单一准确率指标，完全忽略提示格式引入的方差和答案可解析性差异，导致统计结论脆弱且不可靠。亟需系统性量化和标准化这种格式敏感度。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了LLM基准测试方法论中缺乏格式方差量化指标的空白——现有工作仅关注提示内容设计，忽略格式变化带来的统计脆弱性，且缺乏统一的指标来评估和报告这种敏感度。

methodology.approach_summary: 提出了一套系统性评估LLM对提示格式变化敏感程度的方法。引入两个互补指标：格式敏感指数(FSI，衡量不同包装器下准确率的波动范围)和可解析性敏感指数(PSI，衡量答案可解析性的相应波动范围)。在token级别受控协议下，通过系统的格式变体生成实验设计，隔离格式变量对模型输出的影响。在140,000次OpenRouter API调用、7个QA任务、5种包装器家族和4种指令模型(7B-72B参数)上开展大规模实证研究，并使用固定效应回归分析可解析性与准确率的因果关系。
key_innovations: 提出FSI和PSI两个互补指标，首次系统量化提示格式变化对LLM基准测试得分的影响及其统计显著性
通过token级别受控协议隔离格式变量，揭示不同模型间格式敏感度存在超过30倍的巨大差异，且主要由合规失败(c)解释
使用固定效应回归方法证明可解析性是准确率的强预测因子，即使在控制任务、模型、包装器变量后仍然成立
inspiration_sources: LLM评估方法论（基准测试设计、排行榜统计有效性）
提示工程（prompt formatting, structured output parsing）
计量经济学中的固定效应回归模型

experimental_rigor.benchmark_coverage: 覆盖7个QA任务(涵盖不同的推理和知识类型)、5种提示包装器家族(不同格式模板变体)、4种指令模型(参数量从7B到72B不等)，共计140,000次OpenRouter API生成实验，规模较为充分
experimental_rigor.claimed_improvement: 揭示了格式敏感度在不同模型间存在超过30倍的差异；证明可解析性是准确率的强预测因子，即使在控制任务、模型和包装器变量后依然成立；论证了不报告包装器方差和合规性的统计脆弱性

stated_limitations: 实验仅覆盖QA类任务，未涵盖生成式或开放式任务
仅依赖OpenRouter API调用，可能受API路由和部署差异影响
模型数量有限(4个)，且均为指令调优模型
reviewer_concerns: 仅4个模型和7个任务，结论的泛化性有待更大规模验证
FSI和PSI作为聚合指标较为简洁，可能无法捕获格式与模型能力之间的深层交互
OpenRouter作为中间层引入的延迟、版本和路由不确定性可能引入额外噪声
未与现有的提示鲁棒性度量方法进行直接对比
缺少对FSI/PSI指标自身稳定性的重复实验验证
limitations_and_honesty.generalization_concern: 实验范围限于QA任务和指令调优模型，在生成式、开放式或创作类任务上的格式敏感度模式可能存在本质差异；在更大规模模型(如GPT-4级别)或不同架构(如MoE)上的表现尚未验证；不同提示语言文化和标注风格的泛化性存疑。

title: Replicating Belief, Not Bits: Epistemic State Replication for Agentic Systems
author: [[Jun He, Deying Yu]]
description: arXiv:2607.09748v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In distributed systems, the classical State Machine Replication (SMR) model assumes that correct replicas execute deterministic transitions to yield identical bitwise states. However, the rise of agentic distributed systems -- where autonomous, stochastic, and model-driven agents orchestrate infrastructure -- presents scenarios where deterministic, bitwise replication is insufficient. Replicas operating with generative models may exhibit divergent reasoning paths, summaries, and token boundaries, yet reach semantically equivalent and correct operational decisions. Forcing bitwise agreement across these stochastic participants degrades execution flexibility, induces context amnesia, and limits performance. We argue that in such settings replicas should agree on belief, not bits. We propose Epistemic State Replication (ESR), a belief-replication layer for agentic distributed systems that shifts the replication boundary from data visibility to knowledge visibility. We formalize the epistemic node state as a pair K = (L, B) separating the deterministic, immutable evidence log (L) from the stochastic, evolving belief lineage (B). To govern execution safety, we define Semantic Linearizability, which requires operations to reflect the latest committed operational meaning within a verifier-bounded semantic compatibility metric, and Bounded Eventual Coherence, which bounds expected semantic divergence under fair delivery, monotonic evidence, bounded verifier disturbance, and a contractive graft operator. We outline protocols for propagating derived insights using structured epistemic deltas, and formalize Verifiable Semantic Rollbacks to prune faulty premises from belief lineages without inducing context amnesia. We prototype ESR and report preliminary simulation results that show feasibility under the stated assumptions and illustrate reductions in secondary cognitive faults.
tldr: 提出信念状态复制（ESR），将智能体分布式系统的复制边界从数据可见性移至知识可见性。
objective_summary: 该论文提出Epistemic State Replication（ESR），一种面向智能体分布式系统的信念复制层。将节点状态形式化为K=(L,B)，分离确定性证据日志与随机信念谱系，定义语义线性化与有界最终一致性作为安全执行规则，并提出了可验证语义回滚机制。初步仿真验证了可行性。
key_logic_flow: 传统状态机复制要求确定性比特级一致，但智能体系统使用生成式模型产生随机推理路径，比特级一致不再适用。
论文提出ESR，将复制边界从数据可见性转移到知识可见性，让副本在信念层面而非比特层面达成一致。
节点状态形式化为K=(L,B)，L为不可变的确定性证据日志，B为随机演化的信念谱系。
定义语义线性化，确保操作在验证器限定的语义兼容度内反映最新提交的操作含义。
定义有界最终一致性，在公平投递、单调证据等假设下限定语义偏差上界。
提出结构化信念增量传播协议和可验证语义回滚机制，在不引发上下文遗忘的前提下剪除错误前提。

paper_metadata.title: Replicating Belief, Not Bits: Epistemic State Replication for Agentic Systems

research_problem.core_question: 在基于生成式模型的智能体分布式系统中，如何设计一种超越经典状态机复制（SMR）的复制协议，使副本间达成语义一致的信念状态而非严格的比特级一致？
research_problem.motivation: 随着AI智能体系统在分布式基础设施编排中的广泛应用，传统的状态机复制（SMR）要求副本执行确定性转换以获得比特级一致的状态。然而，基于生成模型（如LLM）的智能体存在随机推理路径、摘要差异和token边界分歧，强求比特级一致不仅限制了执行灵活性，还会导致上下文遗忘（context amnesia）并严重损害性能。这一根本矛盾在现有的分布式系统理论中缺乏解决方案。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 现有SMR模型要求副本间保持严格的比特级状态一致，无法适应基于生成式模型的智能体系统中推理路径的随机性、语义等价但形式不同的输出、以及上下文连续性需求之间的根本矛盾。分布式系统理论缺少一种允许副本在语义层面达成一致、同时在表示层面容忍差异的复制范式。

methodology.approach_summary: ESR提出了一种信念级复制层，将副本节点状态分解为两个独立组件：确定性不可变的证据日志（L）和随机演化的信念谱系（B）。L记录不可篡改的原始事实与操作，B存储基于证据推导出的认知状态及其演化历史。为约束系统行为，论文形式化定义了语义线性化（Semantic Linearizability），要求操作反映最新的已提交操作语义含义，并通过有界验证器（verifier）在语义兼容性度量内确保正确性；同时定义了有界最终一致性（Bounded Eventual Coherence），在公平投递、单调证据、有界验证器扰动和收缩性嫁接算子条件下约束语义发散的上界。协议使用结构化的认知增量（epistemic deltas）传播衍生见解，并通过可验证语义回滚（Verifiable Semantic Rollbacks）从信念谱系中剪除错误前提而不引发上下文遗忘。
key_innovations: 提出Epistemic State Replication（ESR）范式，将复制边界从数据可见性迁移到知识可见性，从根本上重新定义了分布式系统在AI智能体时代的一致性质
形式化定义语义线性化（Semantic Linearizability）和有界最终一致性（Bounded Eventual Coherence）两种新的一致性模型，为基于信念的复制提供了严格的数学基础
提出可验证语义回滚（Verifiable Semantic Rollbacks）机制，在不引发上下文遗忘的前提下从信念谱系中剪除错误前提，解决了经典SMR回滚操作在智能体系统中的适用性问题

title: Grounding Spatial Relations in a Compact World Model: Instruction Leakage and a Goal-Free Dynamics Fix
author: [[Yufeng Wang, Lu Wei, Haibin Ling]]
description: arXiv:2607.06925v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compact world models that condition on a language goal promise to ground relations such as ``put the red block left of the blue block'' using a sparse set of explicit \emph{reference anchors}. We ask when such references actually ground a relation, and identify a trap: a goal-conditioned predictor reaches a striking $0.90$ relation-readout accuracy, yet this is \emph{instruction transcription}, not perception. Withholding the goal collapses it to chance ($0.90\!\to\!0.27$, three seeds) and a counterfactual instruction makes the predicted anchors follow the \emph{false} instruction $94.5\%$ of the time (true scene $2.3\%$; $N{=}256$). Tested across three settings and a within-task ablation, our central claim characterizes the confound: \textbf{instruction leakage occurs when the scored quantity is transcribable from the instruction (when the instruction names the answer) and is essentially independent of how predictive the non-instruction inputs are.} Our tabletop and the external BabyAI benchmark leak, whereas a Language-Table forward-dynamics world model whose instruction names \emph{referents} does not, until the instruction is augmented to name the direction; and degrading the action never increases leakage, the opposite of what predictor-competition predicts. The diagnosis prescribes the fix: keep the goal out of the dynamics (it belongs to the planner's cost) and supervise the \emph{read} path, recovering genuine, instruction-independent grounding ($0.88$, identical with and without the goal). The detection protocol and remedy apply to any goal-conditioned world model whose instruction names the scored quantity.
tldr: 揭示空间关系接地任务中目标条件世界模型的指令泄漏问题，提出将目标从动力学中移除的修复方案。

key_logic_flow: 该论文发现目标条件世界模型在空间关系接地任务中存在指令泄漏问题：模型在0.90的精确度下实际是在转录指令而非真实感知场景。
去除目标指令后模型精确度从0.90骤降至0.27（三组随机种子验证），反事实指令测试中预测锚点94.5%跟随错误指令，真实场景仅占2.3%。
在桌面积木场景和BabyAI基准测试中均存在指令泄漏，而Language-Table前向动力学世界模型在指令仅命名指代对象时不泄漏，直到指令被增强为命名方向。

title: Operational Reframing and Approval-Framed Delegation in Multi-Agent LLM Safety
author: [[Lifei Liu, Haoran Yu, Xiaochong Jiang, Su Wang, Pin Qian, Yihang Chen]]
description: arXiv:2607.07097v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Safety evaluations of multi-agent LLM systems often compare a direct prompt with a planner-executor pipeline and report the difference as a single "pipeline effect." We argue that this aggregate is difficult to interpret because it conflates three mechanisms: harmful intent may be reframed as plausible operational work, the planner may refuse or transform the request, and the executor may act under delegation prompts implying prior approval. To separate these factors, we introduce a five-condition controlled contrast design, evaluated on 30 synthetic harmful scenarios and an exploratory external validation set from four agent-safety benchmarks using LLM-judged compliance. Our results show that aggregate pipeline safety is not a stable architectural property. Operational reframing is the most portable risk signal, increasing compliance for GPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek across both scenario sets, while Claude is comparatively resistant. Planner behavior can offset this risk mainly through refusal; however, when the planner produces executable steps, the executor may become more compliant than under the direct operational baseline. Approval-framed delegation is sensitive to prompt design, model pairing, and scenario source, and a skeptical executor prompt sharply reduces compliance. Raw-direct model rankings can also mispredict deployed planner-executor behavior. Gemini is safest under raw direct prompts in the primary set yet shows the largest amplification with a Claude planner, rising from 8.9 percent to 38.9 percent compliance. GPTs near-zero aggregate pipeline effect instead hides a reframing increase canceled by planner refusal. These findings suggest that multi-agent safety evaluations should report reframing, planner behavior, delegation framing, and model pairing separately before attributing failures to architecture itself.
tldr: 多智能体LLM安全评估应区分操作重构、规划者行为和委托框架三种机制，而非只报告聚合流水线效应。
objective_summary: 本文提出五条件控制对比设计，在30个合成有害场景和四个智能体安全基准上，分离多智能体LLM安全评估中操作重构、规划者行为和批准框架式委托三种机制。实验表明操作重构是最可转移的风险信号，模型配对显著影响实际安全表现。

title: SupplyNetPy: An Open-Source Python Library for High-Fidelity Modeling and Simulation of Arbitrary Supply Chain and Inventory Networks
author: [[Tushar Lone, Neha Karanjkar]]
description: arXiv:2607.09745v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper introduces SupplyNetPy, an open-source, well-documented Python library for modeling and discrete-event simulation of supply chain networks with arbitrary multi-echelon structures. It supports multiple replenishment policies, perishable inventory, node disruptions, and stochastic demand and lead times. All components are extensible via inheritance. Users describe a supply chain as a graph with node and link attributes, while the library handles simulation, providing logs and extensive node and network level performance reports. This paper presents the motivation, design, key features, and architecture of SupplyNetPy, along with detailed validation results (against analytical benchmarks, a commercial tool, and a published case study). A key motivation behind SupplyNetPy's development is programmatic generation and simulation of complex models, enabling design-space exploration, what-if analysis, training data generation, and supply chain digital twins.
tldr: SupplyNetPy 是一个用于任意供应链网络高保真建模和仿真的开源 Python 库。
objective_summary: 该论文介绍了 SupplyNetPy，一个开源的 Python 库，用于具有任意多级结构的供应链网络的建模和离散事件仿真，支持多种补货策略、易腐库存、节点中断、随机需求和前置时间。
key_logic_flow: SupplyNetPy 是一个开源 Python 库，用于对任意多级结构的供应链网络进行高保真建模和离散事件仿真。
该库支持多种补货策略、易腐库存管理、节点中断模拟、随机需求以及随机前置时间等核心功能。
所有组件均通过继承机制实现可扩展，用户可将供应链描述为包含节点和链接属性的图结构。
库自动处理仿真流程，提供详细的运行日志以及节点级和网络级的性能报告。

paper_metadata.title: SupplyNetPy: An Open-Source Python Library for High-Fidelity Modeling and Simulation of Arbitrary Supply Chain and Inventory Networks

research_problem.core_question: 如何构建一个灵活、可扩展、开源的 Python 仿真框架，以支持任意多级结构的供应链网络建模与模拟？
research_problem.motivation: 供应链网络仿真对于设计空间探索、假设分析、训练数据生成和供应链数字孪生等关键应用至关重要。然而，现有的供应链仿真工具多为商业软件（如 AnyLogic、Simio），价格昂贵、扩展性受限，且缺乏对任意多级网络拓扑的原生支持。学术界缺乏一个开源、文档完善、基于 Python 的灵活仿真库，使得研究人员和 practitioners 难以快速原型化复杂的供应链模型并进行大规模实验。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了缺少开源、可扩展、支持任意多级供应链网络拓扑的高保真 Python 仿真库这一空白，为供应链研究社区提供了可编程、可继承的仿真基础设施。

methodology.approach_summary: SupplyNetPy 将供应链网络建模为带有节点和边属性的有向图，采用离散事件仿真引擎驱动仿真时钟推进。库的核心设计围绕可扩展性展开：用户可通过继承机制自定义节点行为（如不同补货策略）、边属性（如随机提前期）和全局策略（如需求生成）。支持多种补货策略（如(s,S)、(R,Q)等）、易逝品库存建模、节点中断事件以及随机需求与提前期。仿真全程记录详细日志，并自动聚合节点级和网络级的性能报告（如服务水平、缺货率、库存周转等）。所有组件通过 Python 类继承实现扩展，用户只需通过字典或 YAML 描述网络结构即可启动仿真。
key_innovations: 支持任意多级供应链网络拓扑（无环图，不限于串行或装配系统），通过图论方法统一建模不同结构
全组件可扩展架构：所有仿真组件（节点、策略、需求生成器、中断模型）均支持通过 Python 继承机制进行自定义
可编程模型生成能力：支持通过脚本程序化生成复杂供应链模型，实现大规模设计空间探索和训练数据自动生成
集成了易逝品库存、节点中断和随机性建模等实际场景关键特性，提升仿真的真实度与工业适用性
inspiration_sources: 离散事件仿真范式（如 SimPy、Arena 等仿真引擎的核心理念）
图论及其在网络流建模中的应用
商业供应链仿真工具（AnyLogic、Simio）的设计经验
运筹学与库存理论中的经典补货策略与库存管理模型

experimental_rigor.benchmark_coverage: 对 SupplyNetPy 进行了三方面的验证：(1) 与解析基准模型的对比验证，确保库存仿真输出与理论值一致；(2) 与商业仿真工具的输出对比，验证跨工具的一致性；(3) 基于已发表论文中的案例重构进行复现验证。验证涵盖了基本库存模型、多级供应链和易逝品等多种场景。
experimental_rigor.claimed_improvement: 作为开源工具，提供与商业工具一致的高保真仿真能力，同时具备更高的灵活性和可扩展性；支持程序化模型生成，填补了现有开源供应链仿真库在任意多级网络结构支持上的空白。

stated_limitations: 论文自身未明确列出局限性（从摘要和标题判断为工具介绍类论文，通常不在摘要层面讨论局限）
reviewer_concerns: 与已有开源仿真工具（如 SimPy、Salabim）的本质区别和增量贡献不足，核心仿真机制是成熟技术的重新封装
大规模网络下的仿真性能（节点数增加时的计算开销）缺乏定量评估
案例验证规模有限，缺少与多个开源替代品的系统性对比
缺少对仿真结果统计有效性（如 warm-up period、replication 数量）的讨论
limitations_and_honesty.generalization_concern: SupplyNetPy 专注于供应链与库存网络领域，领域特异性较强，但其基于图的建模框架在理论上可扩展至其他网络流仿真场景（如物流网络、生产调度）。泛化到非供应链领域需要用户自行扩展组件，缺乏开箱即用的通用仿真能力。

applicable_domains: 供应链管理与优化
库存策略设计与评估
物流网络规划与分析

易逝品供应链管理
供应链数字孪生开发
强化学习训练环境（供应端仿真）
industrial_relevance.cost_efficiency_analysis: 作为开源 Python 库，SupplyNetPy 消除了商业仿真软件的高昂许可费用（如 AnyLogic 单用户授权数千美元/年），降低了供应链仿真的使用门槛。基于 Python 生态（pandas 数据处理、matplotlib 可视化、PyTorch 集成）可以零成本衔接数据分析和机器学习管线。对于已有 Python 技术栈的企业，集成成本极低；但对于非技术用户，需要具备基本的编程能力才能充分利用其可扩展性。长期来看，开源模式有利于社区贡献和定制化开发，成本效益显著优于商业替代方案。

potential_follow_ups: 基于 SupplyNetPy 的强化学习供应链优化基准测试套件
SupplyNetPy 的实时数字孪生接口与工业 IoT 数据集成

title: Measuring Intelligence Beyond Human Scale
author: [[Jerry Han, Rafael Moschopoulos, Ella Colby, Vishrut Goyal, Andrew Tu, Kia Ghods, Mark Braverman, Elad Hazan]]
description: arXiv:2607.07040v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How can we measure intelligence beyond human capability? Human-authored benchmarks saturate, and above human capability, examiners may not know which tasks are both hard and verifiable. We argue that this difficulty is inherent to absolute-scale evaluation and propose a new paradigm based on relative measurement in which models generate public challenges that separate other systems. Aggregating these outcomes yields an adversarial psychometric rating system that can scale with the systems being measured. We describe practical protocols that reduce incentives for private-information attacks, support judge-free adjudication, and naturally scale with agent capabilities. We instantiate the framework across verifiable and open-ended, non-verifiable domains, illustrating how model-generated evaluation can continue to measure systems beyond the human frontier.
tldr: 提出基于对抗心理测量学的模型自生成评估范式，解决超人类能力范围的AI智能测量难题。
objective_summary: 该论文论证了人类标注基准在超越人类能力后必然饱和，提出基于相对测量的新范式：由模型生成公开挑战任务来区分不同系统，聚合结果形成可随被测系统规模扩展的对抗心理测量评级体系，并设计了减少信息攻击动机、支持无裁判裁决的实用协议。
key_logic_flow: 人类标注的基准测试在超越人类能力后会必然饱和，且人类评审者无法判断哪些任务既困难又可验证，这是绝对尺度评估的固有困难。
论文提出基于相对测量的新范式，由模型生成公开挑战任务来区分不同系统，替代传统的绝对尺度评估。
聚合这些对抗性评估结果，形成一种可随被测系统能力规模扩展的对抗心理测量评级体系。
论文描述了减少私有信息攻击动机、支持无裁判裁决且随智能体能力自然扩展的实用协议。
该框架同时覆盖可验证领域和开放性不可验证领域，说明模型生成的评估可以持续衡量超出人类前沿的系统能力。

title: Does AI Understand Imaging? A Systematic Benchmark of Agentic AI for Computational Imaging Tasks
author: [[Ethan Chung, Chuanjun Zheng, Jasper Tan, Jingxi Li, Haopeng Zhang, Huaijin Chen]]
description: arXiv:2607.07189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) and agentic AI have shown strong performance on semantic visual tasks, but it remains unclear whether they can handle the physics and inverse problems that underlie computational imaging. We present ImagingBench, a benchmark of 20 computational imaging tasks spanning five categories: ray and wave optics, image signal processing, inverse reconstruction, computational sensing, and calibration. ImagingBench evaluates three complementary settings: Expert, fixed expert-guided inverse reconstruction; Planner, planner-guided inverse reconstruction; and Forward, forward-system simulation for consistency checking. We benchmark leading proprietary and open-source image-centric multimodal systems, including Gemini, GPT, and Qwen, and compare them with representative task-specific non-agentic baselines. Across tasks, agentic models remain consistently weaker than specialized methods, especially on computational sensing problems such as lensless imaging, event-based reconstruction, time-of-flight imaging, and holography. Planner guidance provides only modest and inconsistent gains over the fixed-prompt Expert baseline. Although the models often generate visually plausible outputs, their reference-based fidelity remains poor, revealing a substantial gap between semantic visual competence and physically grounded imaging performance. ImagingBench provides a unified testbed for measuring this gap and tracking progress in agentic AI for computational imaging.
tldr: ImagingBench基准测试表明，现有VLM和智能体在计算成像任务上远弱于专用方法，存在语义理解与物理成像之间的显著差距。
objective_summary: 研究人员推出ImagingBench基准，包含20个计算成像任务（5大类），用于评估Gemini、GPT、Qwen等VLM和智能体AI在物理和逆问题上的表现。结果表明智能体模型在计算感知任务（无透镜成像、全息术等）上远弱于专用方法，规划器引导仅带来有限的提升。

title: Evaluating SageMath-Augmented LLM Agents for Computational and Experimental Mathematics
author: [[Pavel Snopov, German Magai]]
description: arXiv:2607.06820v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in AI for Mathematics have focused largely on autoformalization and theorem proving, leaving the role of Computer Algebra Systems (CAS) in agentic LLM workflows underexplored. We propose a ReAct-style agentic setup that combines LLM reasoning with verifiable feedback from SageMath, together with Context7 for the up-to-date documentation. We evaluate this agentic setup across frontier models for solving research-level mathematical problems from the RealMath benchmark in a setting that emulates a computational-mathematics research loop. We also propose a refinement to the RealMath benchmark by introducing a multi-step post-processing procedure and a multi-stage validation pipeline, both of which improve the quality and reliability of the extracted problem set. Our experiments reveal substantial performance gains from SageMath access across all evaluated models on +9.7~pp on average, the gains range from 1.5~pp to 27.8~pp and narrow the gap between open-weight and closed models. Qwen~3.7-Max benefits from SageMath the most, while GPT-5.5 achieves the highest solve rate of $75.2\%$ and the lowest token usage among tool-enabled configurations. Our findings suggest that CAS-augmented agents represent a promising direction for assisting mathematicians in computational exploration, and we believe that this work is a step towards automated conjecture discovery. The project repository is available online.

title: When Does In-Context Search Help? A Sampling-Complexity Theory of Reflection-Driven Reasoning
author: [[Yotam Wolf, Noam Wies, Amnon Shashua]]
description: arXiv:2607.06720v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) with extended reasoning has enabled in-context search, in which models iteratively generate, critique, and revise solution attempts. We provide a theoretical analysis of in-context search by modeling it as approximate inference over reasoning traces, where the base model defines a prior and self-reflection provides feedback for posterior updates, and study the resulting inference-time sampling complexity - the number of sequential attempts needed to achieve high success probability. We show that when reflections reliably localize early mistakes, in-context search can yield exponential improvements over the base model, solving problems with exponentially small zero-shot pass rates using only a polynomial number of sequential attempts, whereas when this property fails, conditioning on past attempts offers no asymptotic benefit over parallel sampling. We further show that these gains are robust and learnable: approximate posterior updates suffice, and cross-entropy training on search rollouts recovers the required behavior with polynomial sample complexity. Finally, we show that under a stagewise abstraction of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, the optimal policy extension implements the same posterior reweighting rule. We validate key qualitative predictions of the theory on real large reasoning models.

title: Adversarial Social Epistemology for Assemblies of Humans and Large Language Models
author: [[Mihnea C. Moldoveanu, Joel A. C. Baum]]
description: arXiv:2607.07760v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We outline an adversarial social epistemology (ASE) for densely interactive communicative landscapes in which public assertions are scaffolded by chains of testimony, inference, institutional certification, and tacit trust. In such landscapes, agents have incentives and affordances to distort, color, omit, fabricate, or strategically under-specify information for private, reputational, rhetorical, or material gains. We argue that these phenomena are not adequately captured by familiar descriptions of epistemic bubbles, echo chambers, or misinformation diffusion. What requires explanation is how communicative agents exploit the commitments and entitlements that normally make scaffolded assertions trustworthy. We provide language that delivers the requisite analysis, outline mechanisms that subvert trust in scaffolded public communications, and outline machinery for auditing and redressing trust breaches arising from subverting the auditability of inferential chains, drawing on epistemic networks, enriched with an inferentialist semantics for interpreting assertions.

title: Agentic Neural Architecture Search
author: [[Seokhoon Jeong, Mijung Kim, Taehwan Kim]]
description: arXiv:2607.07984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural architecture search (NAS) methods have grown increasingly efficient, yet they remain bounded by manually engineered search spaces that require substantial domain expertise and must be rebuilt for every new task. Large language models (LLMs) can generate architectures in an open-ended space, but how to optimally divide the labor between LLM-driven design and NAS-driven search remains unexplored. We propose a mechanism that bridges these two paradigms: an LLM produces a high-quality seed architecture, then decomposes it into a "slotted architecture", a scaffold with named, interchangeable module slots that automatically defines a bounded, task-specific search space for conventional NAS to explore, without manual engineering. We instantiate this mechanism in AgentNAS, a modular three-phase pipeline in which each component's contribution can be measured independently. On 17 tasks spanning classification, dense regression, segmentation, and multi-label tagging across diverse modalities (NAS-Bench-360 and Unseen NAS), AgentNAS establishes a new state of the art on 11 tasks, outperforming published baselines including task-specific expert designs. Ablation studies show that the two search mechanisms are broadly complementary: the LLM-generated seed already surpasses published baselines on the majority of tasks, and NAS delivers additional gains in most cases through combinatorial recombination across slots, a mode of search that independent LLM samples cannot replicate. These patterns hold across three LLMs of different capability levels, confirming that the division of labor is robust. Our code is available at https://github.com/alroimfebruary/AgentNAS.

key_logic_flow: AgentNAS 提出一种将 LLM 驱动的架构设计与传统 NAS 驱动搜索相结合的机制，LLM 生成高质量种子架构后将其分解为"插槽架构"。

在分类、密集回归、分割和多标签标注等 17 个任务上，AgentNAS 在 11 个任务上达到新 SOTA，超越已有基线。
消融实验表明 LLM 生成的种子架构本身已在多数任务上超越基线，而 NAS 通过插槽间组合重组带来额外增益，此模式独立 LLM 采样无法复制。
该结论在三种不同能力水平的 LLM 上均成立，验证了 LLM 与传统 NAS 之间任务分工的鲁棒性。

title: Nigeria Machinery: A Low-Resource Industrial Dataset with a Domain-Grounded Reasoning Layer
author: [[Gospel Bassey, Vincent Fakiyesi]]
description: arXiv:2607.07883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: There is relatively little, public, and model-ready data on industrial machinery for African economies. This makes it hard to do quantitative analysis or to train language models on numeric tasks grounded in that setting. We release two things to help with part of this problem. The first is the Nigeria Machinery Usage and Failures Dataset: 89 machine-level records across 28 indicators, covering Nigeria's manufacturing and oil and gas sectors from 2006 to 2025. Every record names a public source and is decoded by a codebook. The second is a method for building chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning examples from these sparse numeric values. The result is 94 prompt, completion, and reasoning-trace rows. In every row, the prompt names the real indicator, subsector, year, and source of the record it comes from. The data adaptation work was carried out by Adaption Labs. Along the way we describe a problem that is common when language models are used to build datasets. The prompts can match the real numbers while saying nothing about the real domain. We show that fixing this raises the share of domain-grounded prompts from 1 out of 78 in an earlier release to 94 out of 94, and that every retrieval answer now matches its source value (84 out of 84). We release the data, the reasoning layer, and a per-row provenance file under CC-BY-4.0. We are clear about the limits. With 89 records and 17 indicators that have only one observation, this is a reference and seed dataset, not a large training set. Most reasoning rows are retrieval rather than multi-step computation.

title: Faithful, Not Corrective: Message-Format Effects in Multi-Hop Agent Relays Are Tier-Dependent
author: [[Zayx Shawn]]
description: arXiv:2607.09678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When LLM agents hand off information to one another, does the message format matter? Two literatures disagree: format-optimization work reports that structured messages cut cost without hurting accuracy, while format-restriction work finds that imposing structure degrades generation -- and neither measures what happens when a message traverses multiple hops, where copy fidelity, not one-shot generation, dominates. We introduce a controlled relay testbed: briefs of twelve programmatically generated atomic facts are re-encoded hop-by-hop in five formats (free NL, precision-instructed NL, JSON, triples, key-value) over six hops, scored by a fixed strong grader against programmatic ground truth, across two relay-capability tiers, a cognitive-load condition, and a paired-fork error injection. We find that message-format effects are tier-dependent. (i) Under faithful-relay instructions a strong relay is nearly lossless -- the documented "telephone-game" collapse does not occur -- and adding per-hop cognitive load leaves format-level fidelity unchanged (within +/-1.8 points) while raising generation cost by 24-53%. (ii) Under a weak (1.5B) relay the across-format spread of six-hop recall grows by a factor of 8.7 (from 2.3 to 20.5 points), driven by two opposing mechanisms -- an encoding toll paid by the rigid formats and drift resistance specific to the fixed-key JSON schema -- that flip the format ranking in transit. (iii) In a paired-fork injection, an injected wrong value, once present, persists to the final hop in 83-100% of chains in every format, closely matching each format's retention of the true value, with no detectable collateral damage to neighboring facts. Structure buys a faithful, error-localizing channel -- not an error-correcting code -- and format choice should follow the weakest relay in the pipeline.

paper_metadata.title: Faithful, Not Corrective: Message-Format Effects in Multi-Hop Agent Relays Are Tier-Dependent

research_problem.core_question: 在多跳LLM Agent接力传话中，消息格式（自由文本 vs 结构化格式）对信息保真度的影响是什么？该影响是否依赖于接力模型的能力层级？
research_problem.motivation: 多Agent系统中，信息需要在不同LLM Agent之间逐跳传递（类似传话游戏）。现有研究存在矛盾结论：格式优化方向的工作认为结构化消息（JSON/三元组）可降低成本而不损失准确性；格式约束方向的工作发现结构化会损害生成质量。但两者都未测量消息经过多跳传输后的拷贝保真度（copy fidelity）。随着多Agent编排系统在实际应用中日益普及，理解消息格式在多跳接力中如何影响信息保真度对系统设计至关重要。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了多跳Agent接力场景中消息格式对信息保真度影响的系统性实证空白，特别是揭示了格式效应依赖于接力模型能力层级这一关键发现，调和了此前文献中相互矛盾的结论。

methodology.approach_summary: 论文设计了一个受控的接力测试平台：将12条程序化生成的原子事实以5种格式（自由自然语言、精确指令自然语言、JSON、三元组、键值对）逐跳重新编码，跨越6跳，由固定强评估器根据程序化真实值评分。实验在两个接力能力层级（强模型 vs 1.5B弱模型）、认知负载条件和配对分支错误注入场景下进行对比。通过精确测量每跳的信息召回率和格式转换代价，系统性地揭示了格式选择与模型能力之间的交互效应。
key_innovations: 提出多跳Agent接力保真度的受控测试实验框架，将原子事实逐跳追踪而非仅测单次生成质量，填补了该领域的系统评估空白
发现格式效应具有层级依赖性（tier-dependent）：强接力下几乎无损（无电话游戏崩塌），而弱接力下格式间召回率差距扩大8.7倍
揭示两种相反的机制——刚性格式的编码代价（encoding toll）与固定键JSON范式的漂移抵抗（drift resistance），两者在传输过程中翻转格式排名
通过配对分支错误注入实验证实结构格式提供的是保真、错误定位的信道（error-localizing channel），而不是纠错码（error-correcting code），这一结论具有实践指导意义

LLM格式优化（format-optimization）与格式约束（format-restriction）两派文献的矛盾观点
多Agent编排系统（如AutoGen、CrewAI）中消息传递的设计实践

experimental_rigor.claimed_improvement: 非传统提升类论文，核心贡献为实证发现：（1）强接力下格式效应极小，电话游戏崩塌不出现；（2）弱接力下格式间6跳召回率差距从2.3分扩大到20.5分；（3）错误注入后错误持续率83-100%，结构与自由格式无显著差异；（4）认知负载使成本增加24-53%但不改变格式级保真度

stated_limitations: 实验使用程序化生成的原子事实而非真实自然文本，可能低估了真实场景中的信息扭曲程度
仅测试了5种特定格式，未覆盖所有可能的消息表示方式
单评估器（固定强模型）评分可能引入评估偏差
接力指令设定为'忠实转发'（faithful-relay），真实Agent可能不遵守此指令
reviewer_concerns: 原子事实过于简化，真实多Agent交互中信息更复杂、更模糊、更上下文依赖，结论的泛化性存疑
仅测试了一个弱模型（1.5B），无法确定弱接力效应是否扩展到其他小型模型或模型系列
5种格式的具体实现方式（如JSON schema的具体设计）可能对结果产生显著影响，但未进行schema变体实验
评估器本身也是LLM，评估保真度可能受评估器自身偏好影响（如对特定格式更有偏见）
未探讨多Agent协作中的信息融合、推理、决策等高阶能力，仅关注纯拷贝保真度
limitations_and_honesty.generalization_concern: 实验基于12条原子事实和程序化生成的简单信息单元，真实应用场景中的信息往往更复杂、模糊、上下文依赖强。结论能否推广到长文本推理、多源信息融合、非忠实接力指令等场景尚不明确。此外，弱接力仅测试了单一1.5B模型，不同弱模型的格式敏感性可能差异显著。

applicable_domains: 多Agent编排系统设计（AutoGen、CrewAI、LangGraph等框架的消息格式选择）

industrial_relevance.cost_efficiency_analysis: 核心发现可直接指导工程实践：在强模型接力场景中，格式选择应优先考虑成本和易用性而非保真度（格式间差异极小）；在混合层级系统中，应按照最弱接力模型的能力选择格式（弱模型对刚性格式更敏感）。认知负载实验表明增加中间指令会显著增加成本（24-53%）而不提升保真度，建议在管道设计中避免冗余提示。这些发现无需额外算力即可落地，具有直接的成本优化价值。

related_work_context.advancement_over_prior: 此前两类文献关注单次生成质量且结论矛盾，本文首次系统性地研究了多跳传输场景下的格式效应，并通过引入'模型能力层级'这一调节变量调和了矛盾结论。同时发现的'编码代价'与'漂移抵抗'两种对立机制是对格式效应内在机理的深入揭示，超越了此前仅关注端到端性能的浅层比较。

title: Neuro-Agentic Control: A Deep Learning-based LLM-Powered Agentic AI Framework for Controlling Security Controls
author: [[Saroj Gopali, Bipin Chhetri, Deepika Giri, Sima Siami-Namini, Akbar Siami Namin]]
description: arXiv:2607.09076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cyberattacks on operational technology are increasingly causing costly downtime and physical damage, exposing the limitations of traditional rule-based monitoring in industrial IoT environments. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have strong semantic reasoning abilities to assist in decision support, their hallucinatory nature presents unacceptable safety liabilities for closed-loop control. This paper introduces a neuro-agentic control framework, a novel architecture that couples an LLM-based planner (i.e., such as Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite) with a pre-trained Time-Series Foundation Model (TimesFM), to achieve physics-grounded autonomous defense. The paper introduces a ``Counterfactual Physics Injection'' mechanism that simulates the impact of LLM-proposed interventions within the numerical latent space of the foundation model before actuation, while allowing the system to reject hallucinatory or unsafe actions. Evaluated on an industrial dataset (e.g., the Secure Water Treatment (SWaT)) in the context of stochastic attack scenarios, the framework exhibited better performance compared to LSTM and TCN baselines. The Neuro-Agentic Loop prevented five breaches (33.3%) below the threshold versus LSTM (26.7%) and TCN (13.3%), with zero physically invalid (hallucinated) actions executed. These results demonstrate the efficacy of using foundation models as deterministic ``Sentinels'' to safeguard agentic AI in critical infrastructure.
tldr: 提出神经-智能体控制框架，将LLM规划器与时间序列基础模型耦合，通过反事实物理注入机制防止幻觉行为在工控安全中执行。
objective_summary: 该论文提出神经-智能体控制框架，将基于LLM的规划器（Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite）与预训练时间序列基础模型TimesFM结合，通过反事实物理注入机制在工业物联网环境中实现物理约束下的自主防御。在SWaT数据集上评估，该框架防止了33.3%的安全阈值突破（5次），优于LSTM的26.
key_logic_flow: 论文提出神经-智能体控制框架，将LLM规划器（Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite）与时间序列基础模型TimesFM耦合，用于工控环境中的自主安全防御。
框架引入"反事实物理注入"机制，在执行之前在TimesFM的数值潜在空间中模拟LLM提议的干预效果，从而拒绝幻觉或不安全行为。
在SWaT（安全水处理）工业数据集上的随机攻击场景评估中，该框架相比LSTM和TCN基线表现出更优的防御性能。
神经-智能体循环防止了33.3%的安全阈值突破（5次），高于LSTM的26.7%和TCN的13.3%，且零次执行物理无效的幻觉行为。
实验结果证明基础模型可作为确定性"哨兵"来守护关键基础设施中的智能体AI系统，解决LLM幻觉在闭环控制中的安全隐患。

paper_metadata.title: Neuro-Agentic Control: A Deep Learning-based LLM-Powered Agentic AI Framework for Controlling Security Controls

research_problem.core_question: 如何利用大语言模型的语义推理能力实现对工业物联网/运营技术（OT）环境中安全控制器的自主闭环控制，同时避免幻觉引发的物理安全隐患？
research_problem.motivation: 针对运营技术（OT）设施的网络攻击日益导致代价高昂的停机时间和物理损坏，传统基于规则的监控方法在工业物联网环境中暴露出明显局限性。大语言模型具备强大的语义推理能力可用于决策辅助，但其固有的幻觉特性在闭环控制场景中带来不可接受的安全风险。因此需要一种既能发挥LLM推理优势、又能确保物理安全的混合架构。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了LLM驱动的自主安全控制系统中缺乏物理感知验证机制的空白——现有方法要么完全依赖规则（缺乏灵活性），要么直接使用LLM进行决策（存在幻觉风险），缺乏一种在LLM推理与物理世界约束之间建立安全界面的架构设计。

methodology.approach_summary: 提出一种神经智能体控制框架（Neuro-Agentic Control），核心架构将LLM规划器（如Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite）与预训练的时间序列基础模型TimesFM耦合。关键创新在于"反事实物理注入"（Counterfactual Physics Injection）机制：在LLM提出干预措施后，先在TimesFM的数值潜空间中模拟该干预的物理影响，再决定是否执行。系统据此可以拒绝幻觉性或物理上不可行的动作。该架构形成一个"神经智能体循环"（Neuro-Agentic Loop），其中TimesFM充当确定性的"Sentinels"（哨兵）角色，对LLM的输出进行物理合理性校验。
key_innovations: 提出LLM规划器 + 时间序列基础模型（TimesFM）的耦合架构，将语义推理能力与物理数值建模分离，形成可验证的闭环安全控制系统
反事实物理注入机制：在TimesFM的数值潜空间中模拟LLM提议干预的物理后果，实现零幻觉动作执行
构建神经智能体循环（Neuro-Agentic Loop），以基础模型作为确定性的守门人对LLM输出进行物理合理性验证，解决LLM在关键基础设施闭环控制中的安全可靠性问题
inspiration_sources: 大语言模型的语义推理与规划能力
时间序列基础模型（TimesFM）的数值预测能力
强化学习中的actor-critic架构中的验证/拒绝机制
工业控制系统中的安全联锁（safety interlock）设计理念

experimental_rigor.benchmark_coverage: 仅在单一工业数据集Secure Water Treatment (SWaT)上进行评估，测试场景为随机攻击场景。缺乏在多样化工业场景（如电力、制造、油气管道）上的验证。
experimental_rigor.claimed_improvement: 在SWaT数据集随机攻击场景下，神经智能体循环在阈值以下防止了5次安全违规（33.3%），优于LSTM（26.7%）和TCN（13.3%），且实现了零物理无效（幻觉）动作执行

reviewer_concerns: 仅在SWaT单一数据集上验证，缺乏跨领域泛化性证据
基线方法仅包括LSTM和TCN两种传统时序模型，未与最新的安全控制方法（如基于强化学习的IDS、基于图神经网络的异常检测等）对比
未报告TimesFM和LLM的计算资源消耗与推理延迟，这对于工业实时控制场景至关重要
随机攻击场景的定义和生成方式不透明，无法判断攻击强度是否公平对比
缺少消融实验，无法量化"反事实物理注入"机制本身的独立贡献
LLM选择为Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite，缺乏跨模型泛化性分析（如GPT-4、Claude等）
limitations_and_honesty.generalization_concern: 该框架仅在SWaT（水处理系统）单一场景中验证，工业OT环境涵盖电力、油气、制造、交通等多个领域，每个领域的物理动态特性和攻击面差异巨大。当前缺乏证据表明该框架能泛化到水处理之外的场景。此外，TimesFM在未见过的物理系统上的外推能力也未得到验证，在真实部署中可能面临分布外（OOD）泛化挑战。

applicable_domains: 工业水处理设施安全防护
关键基础设施（电力、油气管道）的入侵检测与自主防御
工业物联网（IIoT）环境中的安全控制自动化
需要LLM决策但要求高安全性的任何物理控制系统
industrial_relevance.cost_efficiency_analysis: 该框架同时依赖LLM（如Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite）和TimesFM两个大型模型进行推理，计算开销显著高于传统LSTM/TCN基线。在工业场景中，每次控制决策需要经过"LLM提议→TimesFM模拟验证→执行/拒绝"的完整循环，引入额外延迟。考虑到工业控制通常需要毫秒级响应，而LLM推理耗时往往在秒级，该框架在实时性要求高的场景中可能不满足工业级延迟要求。此外，部署和运行两个大模型的硬件成本（GPU集群）对于中小型工业设施而言可能难以承受。长期看，若模型量化和蒸馏技术能大幅压缩尺寸，成本效益可能改善。

closest_prior_works: 传统基于规则和LSTM/TCN的工业异常检测与安全控制方法
将LLM用于网络安全决策支持（如SOC辅助分析）的相关研究
Time-Series Foundation Model (TimesFM) 相关工作
AI Agent安全对齐（AI safety alignment）领域关于LLM行为约束的研究
related_work_context.advancement_over_prior: 相比传统LSTM/TCN方法，该框架首次将LLM的语义推理能力引入工业安全控制的闭环决策中，并通过TimesFM的数值潜空间反事实模拟来约束LLM的幻觉行为。相比直接使用LLM进行控制的方法，该架构通过"哨兵"验证机制解决了LLM在物理安全关键系统中的可部署性问题，实现了零幻觉动作执行。这是将AI agent从"建议者"角色推进到"安全执行者"角色的一个重要步骤。
potential_follow_ups: 在更多工业领域（电力、化工、制造）验证框架的泛化能力
探索更轻量级的替代方案（如小型时序模型替代TimesFM）以降低延迟和成本
改进反事实模拟的保真度，从潜空间模拟扩展到混合物理模型模拟
研究LLM规划器的多步推理能力与闭环控制策略的长期优化
针对不同攻击类型（如隐蔽攻击、APT攻击）的防御有效性分析
构建端到端的安全控制benchmark，涵盖多种OT场景和攻击范式的标准化评估套件

title: Context Graphs for Proactive Enterprise Agents
author: [[Avinash Kumar]]
description: arXiv:2607.07721v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic frameworks have advanced enterprise AI considerably, yet agents remain fundamentally reactive: they wait for a human query before acting. This paper argues that genuine enterprise productivity gains require proactive agents: systems that surface relevant, actionable information to workers before they ask. We propose the Context Graph, a live relational data structure that models enterprise entities, their relationships, and state transitions over time. Built on this graph, we define a Delta Detection Engine that continuously monitors state changes, a Proactivity Scorer that ranks candidate insights by urgency, relevance, and persona-fit, and a Surfacing Layer powered by an LLM that delivers ranked notifications with grounded explanations. We formalize each component, derive a unified Proactivity Score function, and provide a complete end-to-end Python implementation using NetworkX and the Anthropic Claude API. Evaluation across three generic enterprise case studies (contract lifecycle management, engineering incident response, and sales pipeline hygiene) demonstrates that context-graph-driven proactivity achieves Precision@5 of 0.83, a false positive rate of 0.11, and reduces mean time to surface from 47 minutes (reactive baseline) to under 30 second.
tldr: 提出Context Graph使企业AI代理从被动响应变为主动推送。
objective_summary: 该论文提出Context Graph实时关系数据结构，对企业实体关系与状态变化建模。基于此构建Delta检测引擎、主动评分器和LLM展示层，使用NetworkX和Anthropic Claude API实现。在合同管理、事件响应和销售管道中Precision@5达0.83，误报率0.
key_logic_flow: 论文指出当前企业AI代理本质上是被动响应的，仅在收到人类查询后才执行操作，真正的生产力提升需要主动代理。
提出了Context Graph（上下文图），一种实时关系数据结构，用于对企业实体、实体间关系及随时间变化的状态转换进行建模。
基于Context Graph构建了三大组件：Delta Detection Engine持续监控状态变化、Proactivity Scorer按紧迫性/相关性/角色匹配度排序候选洞察、Surfacing Layer通过LLM生成带依据解释的排名通知。
提供了完整的端到端Python实现，使用NetworkX和Anthropic Claude API，并形式化了统一的Proactivity Score函数。
在合同生命周期管理、工程事件响应和销售管道三个企业场景中评估，Precision@5达0.83，误报率0.11。
相比被动基线平均47分钟的展示时间，Context Graph驱动的主动系统将展示时间缩短至30秒以内。

paper.paperTitle: Context Graphs for Proactive Enterprise Agents

impact_score.reason: 论文提出Context Graph概念并提供了完整的形式化定义（Proactivity Score统一函数）、可复现的Python实现（NetworkX + Claude API）以及三个场景的量化评估（Precision@5=0.83），技术路线清晰、学术贡献扎实。然而，该工作尚处于学术原型阶段，三个评估场景均为合成案例而非真实企业生产环境，从论文到大规模工程落地仍需克服实时图维护、延迟控制、企业系统集成等显著挑战。短期来看，该论文不会直接改变行业格局，但其主动代理范式具备被主流企业AI平台逐步吸收的潜力，属于值得关注的技术方向而非即时冲击力事件。综合上述分析，

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: Context Graph作为RAG的演进方向，使AI代理从被动问答走向主动洞察推送，且附有可直接运行的NetworkX实现代码

hype_assessment.reason: 论文是标准的学术研究文体，没有出现'颠覆性''革命性'等PR话术。提供了完整的形式化定义（Delta Detection Engine、Proactivity Score函数）、开源级Python实现（依赖仅NetworkX和Anthropic Claude API）以及三个场景的量化评估（含Precision@5、误报率、平均展示时间等硬指标），属于实打实的技术贡献，不存在概念炒作。

domain_disruption.business_model: 可能重塑企业SaaS产品中AI能力的嵌入方式——从嵌入问答机器人（副驾驶模式）转向主动工作流引擎（自动驾驶模式），提升企业软件的人均产出价值，推动企业AI从'辅助工具'向'数字员工'演进

compound_value.reason: Context Graph 提出的实时关系数据结构+Delta检测引擎+主动评分器三层架构，为企业AI从被动RAG向主动代理进化提供了首个可复现的工程范式。Precision@5达0.83、误报率0.11、展示时间从47分钟降至30秒以内的验证数据证明该方向有实质性价值。从复利视角看，如果Context Graph模式成为企业Agent基础设施的标准组件（类似RAG在知识问答中的地位），其锁定效应很强——一旦企业将实体关系图、状态转换逻辑和评分机制深度嵌入业务流，替换成本极高。但目前处于学术论文阶段，距离商业化产品有距离；核心思路可能被Salesforce、ServiceNow、Atlassian等拥有企业数据主权的平台厂商内部复现并封闭化，独立创业公司面临'数据在场'壁垒。评分7.0：认可方向价值和成为细分基础设施的潜力，但商业化路径和独立复利能力尚需验证。

competitive_casualty: 传统RAG企业搜索平台
被动式ITSM/事件管理工具
market_opportunities: 企业软件厂商可将Context Graph的主动推送理念嵌入CRM、ITSM、合同管理系统中，将被动查询升级为智能预警与自动建议，提升产品竞争力和用户粘性
创业公司可基于该架构开发'企业主动智能层'中间件产品，作为独立插件对接Salesforce、Jira、HubSpot等SaaS平台，收取按洞察推送量定价的订阅费
AI Agent开发团队可将Proactivity Score评分机制引入内部知识助手或数字员工产品，提升其场景感知能力和主动服务触达率，形成差异化卖点

risk_matrix.regulatory: 无
risk_matrix.technological: 该方法依赖NetworkX实现图遍历与状态检测，在企业级大规模生产环境（数万实体、实时流式事件）中可能面临性能和扩展性瓶颈；LLM生成的洞察解释存在幻觉风险，可能导致错误优先级判断或误导性通知
risk_matrix.competitive: 大型企业软件厂商（Salesforce、ServiceNow、SAP、微软）和云平台（AWS、Azure、GCP）可快速将类似主动智能能力内建到平台生态中，挤压独立中间件解决方案的生存空间；LangChain、LlamaIndex等Agent框架也可能集成类似功能
risk_matrix.ethical: 系统误报率0.11意味着约11%的推送为不相关或错误警报，长期可能引发用户'警报疲劳'，反而降低对关键事件的响应效率；持续监控企业实体状态变化可能让员工产生被AI'监视'的隐私顾虑
additional: 企业系统集成复杂度高，需对接多种遗留系统的API、身份认证和数据模型，实施周期和定制成本可能远超预期
用户需要适应'AI主动推送'的新型工作模式，从'拉取查询'到'被动接收'的转变存在组织变革阻力和信任建立门槛

title: LLM-powered reasoning in agent-based modeling
author: [[Sifat Afroj Moon, Dakotah Maguire, Adam Spannaus, Joe Tuccillo, Maksudul Alam, Sudip K. Seal, John Gounley, Heidi Hanson]]
description: arXiv:2607.06757v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent-based modeling (ABM) has the capability to model millions of individuals and their interactions, which is useful for policy making. However, ABMs have traditionally relied on static prior, which prevents the models from adapting to real-time changes. Our research provides a novel approach to addressing this information gap. Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to predict human decision-making. Here, we introduce a scalable Hybrid Agent-based and Language-driven Epidemic (HALE) modeling framework that leverages LLMs to predict human decision-making in an ABM simulation. As a proof-of-concept, we use HALE to simulate COVID-19 and its effects in Salt Lake County, UT.
tldr: 提出 HALE 框架，将 LLM 用于基于智能体的建模以模拟人类决策
objective_summary: 作者针对传统 ABM 依赖静态先验无法实时适应的问题，提出了 HALE 框架，利用大语言模型预测 ABM 模拟中的人类决策，并以 COVID-19 在盐湖县的模拟作为概念验证。
key_logic_flow: 传统基于智能体的建模（ABM）依赖静态先验假设，无法适应实时变化。
大语言模型（LLM）为预测人类决策提供了新的可能性。
作者提出 HALE（混合智能体与语言驱动流行病模型）框架，将 LLM 集成到 ABM 模拟中。
HALE 框架使用 LLM 推理来驱动模拟中智能体的人类决策行为。
以 COVID-19 在犹他州盐湖县的模拟作为概念验证案例。

paper.paperTitle: LLM-powered reasoning in agent-based modeling

impact_score.reason: 该论文提出了将LLM推理能力集成到基于智能体建模（ABM）中的HALE框架，属于学术探索性质的新思路。但仅以COVID-19在盐湖县的模拟作为概念验证，缺乏大规模实验数据支撑及可推广的工程实践。短期内在AI行业中的冲击力有限，不属于改变局部竞争格局或范式转移级别的事件，更多是特定交叉领域（AI+计算社会科学/流行病学）的渐进式创新。

hype_assessment.reason: 论文陈述风格务实，明确指出是概念验证（proof-of-concept），未使用'颠覆'、'革命性'等PR化词汇。方法学创新有限——本质是将现有LLM作为ABM中决策模块的替代，而非底层技术突破。arXiv预印本且应用场景局限（流行病模拟），不存在概念炒作嫌疑。

title: The Harness Effect: How Orchestration Design Sets the Token Economics of Enterprise Agentic AI
author: [[Muayad Sayed Ali, Aliaksandra Novik, Anji Boddupally, Artem Yavorskyi, Chris Nickerson, Daniel Rica, Emily DuGranrut, Felix Leung, Garrett Prince, Grace Barnett, Heath Robinson, Hosain Al Ahmad, Jesse Resnick, Juan Carlos Farah, Jyothi Swaroop Meruga, Leonid Kuznetsov, Luke Gorham, Marie Schmoll, Michael Paciullo, Saumya Das, Sharath Sheripally, Tommy Griscom, Mykyta Osadchyi, Neha Mantri, Nick Westrum, Olivia Benowitz, Parikshith Kulkarni, Radik Chernyshov, Rakshith Vasudev, Rohith Nadimpally, Vikas Gangadevi, Waseem AlShikh]]
description: arXiv:2607.06906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic AI development today runs on token maxing: buying capability with tokens -- longer reasoning traces, more turns, wider tool payloads, bigger replayed contexts -- so tokens per task grow faster than task value. Falling per-token prices mask the pattern; total spend rises anyway. We argue the decisive lever against token maxing is the harness: the orchestration layer that assembles context, exposes tools, sequences turns, delegates work, and carries enterprise observability and governance. We isolate it with a controlled swap: 22 locked evaluation tasks, six foundation models (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1, Gemini Flash 3.5, Qwen 3.6, GLM 5.1, Palmyra X6), changing only the orchestration layer -- a frozen conventional production loop versus the Writer Agent Harness. Holding models constant, the harness cuts blended cost per task 41% ($0.21->$0.12), median wall-clock 44% (48s->27s), and tokens per task 38% (14.2k->8.8k), with task-completion quality at parity (0.78->0.81, directional at this sample size). Efficiency is model-invariant -- every model gets cheaper (33-61%) -- while quality gains are capability-dependent: a model's gain correlates almost perfectly with its baseline strength (r=0.99, n=6), a phenomenon we term harness leverage. Quality per dollar rises 82%; task-completions per million tokens rise from 54.9 to 92.0. On this workload the orchestration layer moved cost per task more than the full spread of the model menu did. We formalize token economics at the orchestration layer (including effective input price under prompt caching), detail the six mechanism families behind the effect -- cache-shape discipline to failure-spend governance -- compare six widely used agent systems on the same axes, and argue the harness is the one component whose efficiency multiplies across every model an organization runs -- present and future.
tldr: 论文通过对比实验证明，智能体编排层（Harness）设计对 Token 经济效率的影响超过模型选择，可降低 41% 成本并提升 82% 性价比。
objective_summary: Writer 研究团队在 22 个任务上用 6 个基础模型对比常规编排与 Writer Agent Harness，发现编排层设计使每任务成本从 0.21 降至 0.12 美元（降 41%），耗时从 48 秒降至 27 秒，Token 消耗从 14.2k 降至 8.8k，质量持平且略增（0.
key_logic_flow: 当前企业智能体 AI 开发普遍存在"Token 最大化"问题：每任务的 Token 消耗增速超过任务价值增速，Token 单价下降掩盖了总支出上升的趋势。
研究提出"编排层效应"（Harness Effect），认为智能体的编排层设计是控制 Token 经济效率的关键杠杆，其影响超过模型选择本身。
通过 22 个锁定评估任务和 6 个基础模型（Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.1、Gemini Flash 3.5、Qwen 3.6、GLM 5.1、Palmyra X6）的受控实验，仅更换编排层后 Harness 使每任务成本降低 41%、中位耗时降低 44%、Token 消耗降低 38%。
质量/美元比提升 82%，每百万 Token 可完成任务数从 54.9 增至 92.0，且任务完成质量保持同等水平（0.78→0.81）。
效率提升与模型无关（所有模型成本降低 33-61%），但质量提升幅度与模型基线能力高度正相关（r=0.99），作者将此称为"编排杠杆效应"（Harness Leverage）。
论文形式化了编排层的 Token 经济模型（含提示缓存的等效输入价格），总结了从缓存形状约束到失败支出治理的六类机制，并对六个主流智能体系统进行了横向比较。

title: Infinity-Parser2 Technical Report
author: [[Zuming Huang, Jun Huang, Kexuan Ren, Baode Wang, Weizhen Li, Jianming Feng, Yu Wang, Yichen Yao, Shijun Lin, Yige Tang, Cheng Peng, Weidi Xu, Wei Chu, Yinghui Xu, Yuan Qi]]
description: arXiv:2607.07836v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present Infinity-Parser2, a large multimodal model that couples a controllable data-synthesis pipeline with multi-task reinforcement learning for end-to-end document parsing, addressing the persistent scarcity of faithfully annotated parsing corpora. Our contributions are threefold. First, we build a scalable synthesis engine, pairing a controllable rendering framework with an iterative refinement loop, and use it to construct and open-source Infinity-Doc2-5M: a 5-million-sample bilingual (Chinese/English) corpus spanning diverse document types, annotated with element bounding boxes, canonical content forms (Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, SMILES, structured charts), and full-page reading order. Second, we introduce a verifiable, multi-task reward system that enables Joint Reinforcement Learning across eight co-trained objectives (document parsing, layout analysis, table parsing, math formula parsing, chart parsing, chemical formula parsing, document VQA, and general multimodal understanding), unifying perception, structure, and reasoning in a single optimization signal. Third, we release two variants under a shared architecture: Infinity-Parser2-Flash, optimized for low-latency inference with a $3.68\times$ throughput gain over Infinity-Parser-7B, and Infinity-Parser2-Pro, engineered for precision-critical settings. Infinity-Parser2-Pro reaches state-of-the-art 87.6% on olmOCR-Bench and 74.3% on ParseBench, surpassing DeepSeek-OCR-2, PaddleOCR-VL-1.5, and MinerU2.5, with strong generalization to charts, chemical formulas, and document VQA.
tldr: Infinity-Parser2 提出可控数据合成流水线与多任务强化学习结合的文档解析方案，在多个基准上达到最优。
objective_summary: Infinity-Parser2 是一个端到端的多模态文档解析大模型，通过 500 万样本中英双语语料库 Infinity-Doc2-5M 和多任务强化学习（8 目标联合训练）统一了感知、结构与推理。团队发布 Flash（低延迟）和 Pro（高精度）两个变体，Pro 在 olmOCR-Bench
key_logic_flow: Infinity-Parser2 构建了可扩展的数据合成引擎，通过可控渲染框架和迭代优化循环生成 500 万样本中英双语语料库 Infinity-Doc2-5M，标注了元素边界框、Markdown/HTML/LaTeX/SMILES 等规范内容和阅读顺序。
论文引入了可验证的多任务奖励系统，在文档解析、版面分析、表格解析、数学公式解析、图表解析、化学公式解析、文档 VQA 和通用多模态理解等 8 个目标上实现了联合强化学习。
团队发布两个架构共享的变体：Infinity-Parser2-Flash 针对低延迟推理优化，吞吐量比 Infinity-Parser-7B 提升 3.68 倍；Infinity-Parser2-Pro 面向精度关键场景。
Infinity-Parser2-Pro 在 olmOCR-Bench 上达到 87.6%，在 ParseBench 上达到 74.3% 的 SOTA 成绩，超越 DeepSeek-OCR-2、PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 和 MinerU2.5。
模型在图表解析、化学公式解析和文档 VQA 等任务上表现出强泛化能力。

title: VectorizationLLM: Smart Vectorization Based AI Assistant
author: [[Ryan Duke]]
description: arXiv:2607.07846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: VectorizationLLM is a specialized Large Language Model based on Google open-weight LLMs. The model is designed to assist students to learn smart vectorization, time/wave vector analysis, piecewise functions, Fourier analysis, and differential equations in MATLAB. The course application is CTEC 247: Applied Computational Analysis II by the Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering Technology at New York Institute of Technology Old Westbury. The LLM model is designed to be an instructive assistant, providing detailed explanations of concepts with examples from in-class notes without providing direct answers to questions. title: Toward Auditable AI Scientists: A Hypothesis Evolution Protocol for LLM Agents
author: [[Izumi Takahara, Teruyasu Mizoguchi]]
description: arXiv:2607.09195v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to play a central role in AI-driven scientific discovery. Equipped with broad knowledge, flexible reasoning, and tool use, they have the potential to autonomously explore and solve scientific problems by repeatedly proposing hypotheses, testing them, and revising their beliefs in the light of the evidence. In current agents, however, these hypotheses, tests, and belief updates are buried in unstructured logs, and no mechanism lets the agent or the human researcher audit that process. Here we propose the Hypothesis Evolution Protocol (HEP), an agent harness that provides hypothesis generation, evaluation, and evolution as explicit, auditable operations. On materials-science research tasks, a HEP-equipped agent operates the hypothesis--test--evidence--belief cycle that planning-style agents lack, generalizes across research questions, and exploits the protocol more fully as the base LLM becomes more capable. These results mark a step toward auditable AI scientists, whose scientific reasoning can be inspected, verified, and built upon.
tldr: 提出假设演化协议(HEP)，让LLM智能体的科学推理过程可审计。
objective_summary: 研究者提出假设演化协议(HEP)，一种让LLM智能体将假设生成、评估和演化为显式可审计操作的框架。在材料科学研究任务中，配备HEP的智能体能有效运行"假设-实验-证据-信念"循环，且随基础LLM能力增强而更好地利用该协议。
key_logic_flow: 当前LLM智能体在自主科学探索中存在假设、测试和信念更新被埋没在非结构化日志中的问题，缺乏审计机制。

HEP能够跨研究问题泛化，且随着基础LLM能力增强，智能体能更充分地利用该协议。
这项工作标志着向可审计AI科学家的迈进，其科学推理过程可以被检查、验证和在此基础上构建。

paper_metadata.title: Toward Auditable AI Scientists: A Hypothesis Evolution Protocol for LLM Agents

research_problem.core_question: 如何让基于LLM的AI科学家在假设生成、测试和信念更新的全过程中具备可审计性？
research_problem.motivation: LLM agent凭借广泛知识、灵活推理和工具调用能力，被期望在AI驱动的科学发现中扮演核心角色，可自主探索并解决科学问题。然而，现有agent的假设提出、实验验证和信念更新过程全部隐藏在非结构化日志中，缺乏让人类研究者审查、验证和构建其科学推理的机制。这种"黑箱"式的科学推理过程违背了科学研究的可复现和可审计基本原则，严重限制了LLM agent在严肃科研场景中的应用可信度。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了LLM agent在科学发现过程中缺乏显式、可审计的假设演化机制的空白。现有规划型agent（如ReAct、Plan-and-Solve）虽能执行多步推理，但其假设生成-检验-证据-信念的完整科学循环是隐式的、不可审计的，人类研究者无法回溯、验证或质疑其推理链条。HEP首次将这一循环作为一级操作原语显式化。

methodology.approach_summary: 提出假设演化协议（HEP），一种agent框架层协议，将科学推理中的假设生成、实验评估和信念更新建模为显式的、可审计的原子操作。HEP equipped agent按照假设→测试→证据→信念的循环运作，每次循环中agent显式记录：当前假设及其置信度、设计的实验或验证方案、观察到的证据、以及基于证据的信念更新决策（保留/修正/放弃假设）。该协议作为一个"agent harness"层包装在基础LLM之上，不修改模型本身，而是通过结构化协议约束推理过程，使其透明化。在材料科学研究任务上验证了该协议的有效性。
key_innovations: 提出HEP协议，将科学推理中隐式的假设-测试-证据-信念循环显式化为可审计、可追溯的结构化操作，这是首个针对LLM agent科学推理可审计性的系统性协议
设计agent harness架构，使HEP可作为插件式协议层兼容不同基础LLM，且协议利用率随基础模型能力增强而自然提升，展现了可扩展性
在材料科学任务上证明HEP-equipped agent能执行规划型agent所不具备的完整科学循环，并能跨不同研究问题泛化
inspiration_sources: 科学哲学中的假设-演绎法（hypothetico-deductive method）和波普尔证伪主义
AI for Science领域中自动化科学家系统的早期探索（如Robot Scientist、Automated Scientific Discovery）
LLM agent领域的工作（ReAct、CoT、Plan-and-Solve等规划与推理框架）
可解释AI（XAI）和AI审计相关研究

experimental_rigor.benchmark_coverage: 在材料科学研究任务上进行了评估，覆盖了假设生成、实验验证和信念更新的完整循环，但未详细说明具体评测基准的数量、规模和多样性
experimental_rigor.claimed_improvement: HEP-equipped agent能够执行规划型agent（如ReAct类方法）所缺乏的假设-测试-证据-信念完整科学循环，在材料科学研究任务上跨问题泛化，且协议利用率随基础LLM能力提升而增长

stated_limitations: 仅在材料科学一个领域的研究任务上进行了验证
协议的有效性高度依赖于基础LLM的推理能力
目前仍处于"迈向"（Toward）可审计AI科学家的初步阶段
reviewer_concerns: 实验验证范围有限——仅覆盖材料科学领域，缺少在生物学、化学、物理学等其他科学领域的跨域泛化验证
基线对比不够全面——仅与"规划型agent"比较，缺乏与最新AI Scientist系统（如Sakana AI的AI Scientist）的定量对比
可审计性的具体度量指标不明确——缺乏定量化衡量"可审计程度"的指标（如推理路径完整率、回溯成功率等）
计算开销分析缺失——HEP协议的显式结构化记录带来的额外token消耗和推理延迟未量化评估
真实科研场景复杂度不足——材料科学benchmark可能与真实科研中开放性问题、噪声数据、实验结果不确定性等挑战存在差距
limitations_and_honesty.generalization_concern: 论文仅在材料科学研究任务上进行了验证，未涉及生物学、化学、物理学等同样需要假设驱动研究的学科。不同学科的科学推理范式差异显著（如生物学更依赖观察归纳，物理学更依赖数学演绎），HEP协议的通用性尚未被证实。此外，真实科研场景中的假设往往涉及更复杂的先验知识整合和实验设计，当前benchmark的简化程度可能高估了协议的泛化能力。

industrial_relevance.cost_efficiency_analysis: HEP协议的核心价值在于提升科研推理的可审计性和可验证性，而非直接降低计算成本。从成本端看，协议层会引入额外的结构化记录和显式推理步骤，增加每次LLM调用的token消耗和推理延迟。从效益端看，可审计的推理过程能显著降低科研结果验证成本、减少不可复现研究的浪费、并为团队协作提供透明的推理基础。整体而言，在追求高可信度的科研场景中（如药物审批、材料认证），额外计算开销是可接受的，但在大规模探索性筛选场景中可能成本过高。需要进一步量化审计收益与计算开销的权衡关系。

title: A Formalization of the Mean-Field Derivation of the Vlasov Equation: AI-Assisted Lean Formalization as a Strategy Game
author: [[Joseph K. Miller]]
description: arXiv:2607.08986v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formalize a research result in the Lean 4 proof assistant by having a mathematician direct an AI system, and frame the activity as a formalization game. The objective is to turn a LaTeX document into Lean. The game is won when the development compiles, contains no sorry, and a machine check shows the target theorems rest on Lean's foundational axioms alone. Reuse is a second check, by a definition we introduce: whether the development yields a self-contained layer of general mathematics the wider library could absorb. The case study is a complete, axiom-clean formalization of well-posedness for the nonlinear Vlasov equation via Dobrushin's mean-field route -- existence, uniqueness, the stability estimate and mean-field limit, and a short-window superposition principle (weak solutions are Lagrangian). The human's role was to direct, not to write proofs: to scope the definitions, steer the decompositions, and triage the library's gaps; the AI agent executed. The formalization certifies the proof of each statement as written; whether the written statement is the intended theorem stays the mathematician's judgment. The optimal-transport machinery that fell out of the build (in particular, properties of the Wasserstein-1 metric and the Kantorovich-Rubinstein duality theorem) separates into a self-contained layer that compiles against Mathlib alone: about a sixth of the development (49 of 299 declarations), behind a 22-declaration interface with no reverse dependency. The headline theorems ran in about a week, the full development in about a month. We report the quantitative claims as observations of one game, not as general laws. The game's rules name no particular system, so the methodological framing is meant to outlast the tools of any one run.
tldr: AI辅助在Lean 4中完整形式化了Vlasov方程的适定性证明，将证明形式化建模为策略游戏。
objective_summary: 研究人员在Lean 4证明助手中，通过AI系统辅助完成了非线性Vlasov方程的适定性证明形式化。人类数学家负责引导定义范围和分解策略，AI系统执行具体证明。完整开发耗时约一个月，核心定理约一周完成。
key_logic_flow: 研究团队提出将AI辅助的数学形式化证明视为一种"策略游戏"，目标是将LaTeX文档转化为Lean 4可编译的代码，且不得包含sorry占位符。
人类数学家负责定义范围、分解策略和排查库的缺口，AI系统负责执行具体的证明编写。
以非线性Vlasov方程的适定性证明为案例，通过Dobrushin平均场路径完成了存在性、唯一性、稳定性估计和平均场极限的完整形式化。
形式化开发共涉及299个声明，其中49个最优传输相关声明（Wasserstein-1度量和Kantorovich-Rubinstein对偶定理）可分离为独立于Mathlib的复用层。
可复用层通过22个声明接口导出，无反依赖，可在更广泛的数学库中吸收使用。
完整形式化耗时约一个月，核心定理约一周完成；形式化验证的是语句的证明正确性，而语句本身是否为预期定理的判断权仍在数学家手中。

research_problem.core_question: 如何通过人类数学家与AI系统的协作策略，高效地将数学定理的LaTeX证明形式化为Lean 4证明助手的可验证代码？
research_problem.motivation: 数学定理的形式化验证是确保证明正确性的重要手段，但传统形式化过程需要大量专业人力投入，效率低下。本文探索通过AI辅助的形式化方法，将数学家从繁琐的证明书写中解放出来，专注于策略制定，从而加速形式化验证的进程，并提升形式化产出的可复用性。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了如何系统化地组织人类数学家与AI在形式化证明中的分工协作这一方法论空白，提出了可复现的'形式化游戏'框架，并将'可复用性'引入形式化质量的评价体系。

methodology.approach_summary: 本文提出了一种将AI辅助的Lean形式化过程框架化为'形式化游戏'的方法。人类数学家扮演'导演'角色，负责定义形式化范围、分解目标、判断数学库缺口并制定策略；AI系统则作为'执行者'负责具体的证明书写。游戏的目标是将LaTeX文档转化为可在Lean中编译并通过公理级检查的代码。游戏胜利条件包括：代码编译通过、不包含'sorry'（未完成证明）、机器检查确认目标定理仅依赖Lean的基础公理。此外还引入'可复用性'作为第二层验证标准——考察形式化开发是否能产生可被更广泛数学库吸收的独立通用数学层。案例研究是对非线性Vlasov方程通过Dobrushin平均场方法的适定性（存在性、唯一性、稳定性估计和平均场极限）的完整形式化，以及一个短时间窗口的叠加原理（弱解为Lagrangian解）。
key_innovations: 提出了'形式化游戏'框架，将AI辅助数学形式化视为一种有明确规则和胜利条件的策略游戏，系统化定义了人机分工模式

title: Feedback-Coupled Memory Systems in Continuous Time
author: [[Stefano Grassi]]
description: arXiv:2607.09714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Feedback-Coupled Memory Systems (FCMS) architecture formalizes closed-loop coordination through four abstract operators, two of which - the agent update operator $f_i$ and the environmental update operator $\Psi$ - are left axiomatically undefined in the original framework. To address this, $f_i$ is defined by Mechanism-Based Intelligence (MBI), where agents update locally through a decentralized price mechanism and economic principles, and $\Psi$ is defined by the Coupled Memory Graph Process (CMGP), a non-Markovian framework where the environment is treated as a physical substrate that records and responds to trajectory history coherently without external forcing. The resulting continuous-time FCMS instantiation achieves Lyapunov global dissipativity governed by the computable threshold $4\beta^2 < 2\eta\mu\gamma^2$. This generalizes both the discrete FCMS stability condition $4\eta\beta^2 < \gamma$ and CMGP's physical bifurcation threshold $\alpha_c = 1/K$, confirming that memory dissipation must outpace feedback gain as a universal organizing principle. Numerical simulation with $N=2$ agents and mean-field validation at $N=10^6$ confirm the stability threshold and the self-reinforcing coordination cascade that emerges when it is violated.
tldr: 论文将反馈耦合记忆系统扩展到连续时间，通过MBI和CMGP定义未指定算子，证明并验证了耗散性阈值条件。
objective_summary: 该论文将反馈耦合记忆系统(FCMS)框架从离散扩展到连续时间形式，通过基于机制的智能(MBI)和耦合记忆图过程(CMGP)分别定义了代理更新和环境更新算子，推导出Lyapunov全局耗散性阈值4β² < 2ημγ²，并通过N=2数值模拟和N=10⁶均值场验证确认了该阈值及违反时出现的自我强化协调级联
key_logic_flow: FCMS框架通过四个抽象算子形式化了闭环协调机制，其中代理更新算子f_i和环境更新算子Ψ在原始框架中被公理化地留为未定义。
论文通过基于机制的智能(MBI)定义了f_i，使代理通过去中心化价格机制和经济原理进行局部更新。
论文通过耦合记忆图过程(CMGP)定义了Ψ，这是一种非马尔可夫框架，将环境视为记录和响应轨迹历史的物理基底，无需外部驱动。
得到的连续时间FCMS实例化实现了由可计算阈值4β² < 2ημγ²控制的Lyapunov全局耗散性。
该结果将离散FCMS稳定性条件4ηβ² < γ和CMGP物理分岔阈值α_c = 1/K统一为同一原理，确认记忆耗散必须超过反馈增益是普适组织原则。
N=2代理数值模拟和N=10⁶均值场验证确认了稳定性阈值，以及当阈值被违反时出现的自我强化协调级联行为。

paper_metadata.title: Feedback-Coupled Memory Systems in Continuous Time

research_problem.core_question: 如何形式化定义反馈耦合记忆系统（FCMS）中原本未指定的代理更新算子和环境更新算子，并建立统一的连续时间稳定性条件？
research_problem.motivation: 原始FCMS框架通过四个抽象算子形式化闭环协调机制，但其中两个核心算子——代理更新算子f_i和环境更新算子Ψ——被留作公理未定义，导致框架无法具体实例化。同时，离散FCMS稳定性条件和CMGP物理分岔阈值分属不同理论体系，缺乏统一的数学理解。本文旨在填补这一空白，为闭环协调系统提供严格的形式化基础。
research_problem.gap_addressed: 填补了FCMS框架中两个核心算子缺乏具体定义的空白，并将离散FCMS稳定条件与CMGP物理分岔阈值统一为连续时间下的单一稳定性判据，揭示了记忆耗散与反馈增益之间的普适定量关系。

methodology.approach_summary: 本文提出了一种连续时间下的反馈耦合记忆系统（FCMS）形式化框架。针对原始FCMS框架中未定义的代理更新算子f_i和环境更新算子Ψ，分别采用两种不同理论进行定义：f_i通过基于机制智能（MBI）的分散价格机制定义，使代理通过经济原则进行局部更新；Ψ通过耦合记忆图过程（CMGP）定义，将环境视为具有记忆的物理基底，以非马尔可夫方式记录和响应系统轨迹历史。在此基础上推导了李雅普诺夫全局耗散性稳定条件4β² < 2ημγ²，统一了离散FCMS稳定性条件4ηβ² < γ和CMGP物理分岔阈值α_c = 1/K。最后通过N=2代理的数值模拟和N=10^6的平均场验证了稳定阈值。
key_innovations: 将MBI的经济学价格机制引入FCMS，为原本公理性的代理更新算子f_i提供了具体定义和动力学机制
将CMGP的非马尔可夫物理基底框架用于定义环境更新算子Ψ，将环境建模为具有轨迹记忆的响应式物理基质
推导出连续时间FCMS的统一稳定性阈值并证明其泛化了离散FCMS和CMGP两个独立框架的稳定性条件，确立了"记忆耗散必须超过反馈增益"作为跨系统的通用组织原则

title: Cost-Effective Agent Harnesses for Abstract Reasoning and Generalization on ARC-AGI-1
author: [[Kabir Moghe, Peter Chin]]
description: arXiv:2607.06764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent progress on ARC-AGI-1 from disclosed architectures has come broadly from two regimes: heavy test-time compute over frontier models (evolutionary search, exhaustive sampling, extended chain-of-thought), or benchmark-specific training in which small models are fine-tuned on ARC data, often with task-specialized architectures. We study a third regime: an open-weight model in non-thinking mode (DeepSeek V3.2) under a strict budget, with no ARC-specific fine-tuning. We study what is recoverable through architecture alone, building agentic harnesses that decompose pattern-discovery and program-synthesis stages explicitly. First, we introduce an Explorer-Definer Pipeline that separates pattern discovery from executable transformation synthesis, implemented as a two-stage agent pipeline. Next, we present the Reflective Orchestrator, which augments the pipeline with autonomous exploration of new transformations when previous hypotheses fail on training pairs. On the ARC-AGI-1 public 400-task evaluation set, the pipeline reaches 57.50% pass@2 at \$0.25 per task, and the orchestrator reaches 67.25% pass@2 at \$0.62 per task. Together these architectures lift a 15.50% one-shot baseline by ~52 points without benchmark-specific training or heavy test-time compute. Furthermore, the orchestrator-driven lift tests a falsifiable diagnostic the pipeline produces; unbiased pass@k analysis suggests the pipeline is generation-bound, not selection-bound (selection via training-pair accuracy captures ~95% of the candidate ceiling) and predicts that significant improvement requires broader generation, not better ranking. The orchestrator implements this prediction via adaptive re-exploration and confirms it (unbiased pass@1 lift +9.81 pp, matching selection-mediated pass@2 lift). An additional pipeline ablation identifies its think tool as a significant component, with removal reducing pass@2 by 5.75 pp.
tldr: 使用DeepSeek V3.2构建agent管道，在ARC-AGI-1上以低成本达67.25% pass@2，无需微调或大规模测试时计算。

key_logic_flow: 论文研究除大规模测试时计算和基准专用微调之外的第三条路线：使用非推理模式的开源模型（DeepSeek V3.2）在严格预算下完成ARC-AGI-1任务。
提出Explorer-Definer Pipeline，将模式发现与可执行变换合成分离为两阶段agent管道。
提出Reflective Orchestrator，在训练对验证失败时自主探索新变换，增强管道能力。
在ARC-AGI-1公开400任务评测集上，Pipeline达57.50% pass@2（$0.25/任务），Orchestrator达67.25% pass@2（$0.62/任务）。
无偏pass@k分析表明管道受限于生成能力而非选择能力（训练对准确率捕获约95%候选上限），Orchestrator通过自适应重探索验证了该预测。
